`设长方形的宽为 \( x \) cm，长为 \( \frac{5}{3}x \) cm。

当宽增加变成正方形后，正方形的边长为 \( \frac{5}{3}x \) cm。

原长方形的面积为：
\[ \text{原面积} = x \times \frac{5}{3}x = \frac{5}{3}x^2 \]

正方形的面积为：
\[ \text{正方形面积} = \left( \frac{5}{3}x \right)^2 = \frac{25}{9}x^2 \]

根据题意，正方形的面积比原长方形的面积多30平方厘米：
\[ \frac{25}{9}x^2 - \frac{5}{3}x^2 = 30 \]

将 \(\frac{5}{3}x^2\) 转换成分母为9的形式：
\[ \frac{25}{9}x^2 - \frac{15}{9}x^2 = 30 \]
\[ \frac{10}{9}x^2 = 30 \]

两边同时乘以9：
\[ 10x^2 = 270 \]

两边同时除以10：
\[ x^2 = 27 \]

取正的平方根：
\[ x = \sqrt{27} = 3\sqrt{3} \]

所以，长方形的宽为 \( x = 3\sqrt{3} \) cm，长为 \( \frac{5}{3}x = 5\sqrt{3} \) cm。

总结：

body:
I have the same issue. 
I see this with an Azure deployment. The response comes in, but at a certain point, the whole response disappears and the error is shown. 

Update: I found the issue. I noticed that responses were fine in the network tab of the developer tools, but the error got triggered around the 30 second mark for the request. So I started searching for components in my setup that had a default timeout of 30. In my case, the GCP backend service connected to the loadbalancer (which had all the lobe-chat instances in a pool) has the default timeout of 30. I had to update the backend timeout like so:
`gcloud compute backend-services update $BACKEND_NAME --project=$PROJECT_NAME --timeout=80`

**I still think this is a bug, because lobe-chat should not entirely remove the response generated so far and leave it in the chat. Even if the connection gets terminated abruptly.**

### 🥰 Description of requirements

I hope the official built-in plug-in dall-e-3 supports client requests:
Most people deploy the Cloud version on vercel, and the vercel free subscription plan has a function timeout limit of 10s. General interfaces such as dall-e for image interfaces return data slowly and easily trigger vercel's timeout, causing the requesting terminal to be unable to generate images.



### 🧐 Solution

Let the request method of drawing interfaces such as dall-e-3 synchronize the settings of the corresponding channel's setting item `Use client request mode`. For such time-consuming operations, users can choose to use client request mode to avoid vercel timeout problems.

好吧是我漏看了
http在服务器和客户端请求都不行。服务器应该是服务商政策，客户端是HTTPS策略

- 要检查是否是HTTPS策略阻止了客户端请求，打开浏览器控制台，看看有没有类似报错
- 要允许在HTTPS链接中发送HTTP请求，转到网站内容设置，允许不安全的连接
- 要开启HTTPS访问并映射到标准端口，可以使用cloudflared（Cloudflare Zero Trust Tunnels + Public Hostname）

Okay, I missed it
HTTP requests neither work on the server nor on the client. The server should follow the service provider's policy and the client should follow the HTTPS policy

- To check whether the HTTPS policy is blocking the client request, open the browser console and see if there are any similar errors.
- To allow HTTP requests to be sent in HTTPS links, go to Site Content Settings, Allow insecure connections
- To enable HTTPS access and map to standard ports, you can use cloudflared (Cloudflare Zero Trust Tunnels + Public Hostname)

----    
### 📦 Deployment environment

Vercel

### 📌 Software version

1.1.6

### 💻 System environment

macOS

### 🌐 Browser

Edge

### 🐛 Problem description

When trying the current server-side database solution, I encountered several pitfalls that were not mentioned in the documentation. You need to explore it yourself (and search related problems of other people from the repo) to solve it.
1. It seems that there is no mention in the existing documents that switching to a server-side database will cause all the data synchronized in the original client to be lost. Because after switching to the server database, all clients were also switched simultaneously, requiring login, and the original synchronization entrance could not be found, resulting in the complete disappearance of my chat records in the past few months. . .
2. I hope the documentation can clearly state the permission requirements for S3 storage. The document is also relatively rough on this. During my deployment process, I only gave all the read and write parts related to AK/AID at the beginning, but in fact, I also opened the anonymous read part of this bucket (this part is for It is also needed for client and OpenAI processing. At first, I thought that our client and program parts are only stored in S3. For client display and sending to the server, they will be read and encoded in Base64 for transmission. It seems that this is not the case. . .If anonymous reading is not enabled, it cannot be displayed or recognized). This is slightly unsafe, please mention it in the documentation.
3. The current solution seems to have a confusing dependence on environment variables, with many unexpected entanglements. For example:
3.1 When I tried to change the deployment for the first time, I just tried to add the environment variable of Database_url, and the variable NEXT_PUBLIC_SERVICE_MODE=server was not configured yet. I originally thought I would just prepare the various variables in sequence and then switch to the server. As a result, after redeployment, it has actually become a server-side mechanism, and you can see a prompt that the database migrate failed in the background.
3.2 After my S3 was ready, I redeployed it for the second time. I found that after everything was deployed, I could not upload images. The client/browser would report an error when uploading images. When I searched the issues of the repo, I found that the original ACCESS_CODE environment variable should be deleted. . . From a literal sense, this environment variable has no direct relationship with this part of the function. Removed environment variables, redeployed and everything worked fine. (No, there is also the permission issue mentioned in the second point just now, which was solved by guessing).


In short, thank you to the team for this update of the server database, but the documentation still needs some improvement, otherwise various problems will inevitably arise for users like us who are not familiar with the code structure.

### 📷 Steps to reproduce

_No response_

### 🚦 Expected results

Improve documentation.

### 📝 Supplementary information

_No response_

As said above, it's easy to miss this for those of us who don't know the detailed code on your side. I thought you were sending it out and displaying it on the client entirely through base64 encoding. Maybe this part needs additional explanation. The use of S3 images in the document is briefly mentioned here: In the case of client db, it is transmitted through base64, but in server db mode, the image url is transmitted directly. In fact, the latter is the most recommended solution by OpenAI ([Document](https://platform.openai.com/docs/guides/vision/managing-images)), which can greatly reduce the traffic overhead of request transmission and improve the response speed. Faster. It’s just that before there was no server db, base64 encoding could only be used. Now that there is a server db, it is naturally better to use the image URL. > I did not set the NEXT_PUBLIC_SERVICE_MODE=server variable at all. When deploying, it actually entered the database migration logic. Database migration and application are two different logics. Database migration only relies on DATABASE_URL and is only executed at build time. This logic is no problem. If you do not configure NEXT_PUBLIC_SERVICE_MODE, the built application will still be client db.

body:
使用Node Postgres的时候，还需要注意自签名证书的问题
部分Postgres服务商使用自签名的CA证书，比如[Aiven](https://aiven.io/docs/platform/concepts/tls-ssl-certificates)

此时如果使用服务方提供的URL的话，就会出现自签名证书问题：
```
❌ Database migrate failed: Error: self-signed certificate in certificate chain
    at /vercel/path0/node_modules/pg-pool/index.js:45:11
    at process.processTicksAndRejections (node:internal/process/task_queues:95:5)
    at PgDialect.migrate (/vercel/path0/node_modules/src/pg-core/dialect.ts:72:3)
    at Object.migrate (/vercel/path0/node_modules/src/neon-serverless/migrator.ts:10:2)
    at runMigrations (/vercel/path0/scripts/migrateServerDB/index.ts:12:3) {
  code: 'SELF_SIGNED_CERT_IN_CHAIN'
```

原因在于，node-postgres在解析`Connection String`的时候行为与官方文档不一致。官方文档里`sslmode=require`的时候，如果本地存在CA证书就检查证书，没有就不检查；
![a6e295c6b14482e1728536b4f70d5475](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/assets/46473171/bf932e4d-af02-4b60-8d97-f6195537cc8f)
而node-postgres的实现中，多出了官方文档中没有的`no-verify`，选择此项时则不会验证证书；而`prefer`、`require`、`verify-ca`、`verify-full` 这4个选项行为完全一致，都是验证所有证书。
![ac3b70478e83d0d2a3842016ddde3c7e](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/assets/46473171/63934c8e-650c-476c-b729-0dc658500c17)

早在2年前便已经有人提出了修复pr使行为对齐官方文档，但至今未合并。https://github.com/brianc/node-postgres/pull/2709

**太长不看**：node-postgres实现跟官方不一致，将URL中的`?sslmode=require`替换为`?sslmode=no-verify`即可。

author: htdohk

body:
plugin settings 是服务端环境变量，它没法发到前端。(否则像serpapi key这种就会暴露)

目前 mj 插件的走的是 standardalone 的 iframe 嵌入，而 lobechat主体和插件的通信是前端 postMessage 的方案。所以目前还不支持这种环境变量的透传。

未来可能会想一个方案允许这种变量发到前端，然后再在前端进行通信
author: arvinxx

body:
> Bot detected the issue body's language is not English, translate it automatically. 👯👭🏻🧑‍🤝‍🧑👫🧑🏿‍🤝‍🧑🏻👩🏾‍🤝‍👨🏿👬🏿         
----    
Plugin settings are server-side environment variables, which cannot be sent to the front-end. (Otherwise things like serpapi key will be exposed)

At present, the mj plug-in uses standardalone's iframe embedding, and the communication between the lobechat main body and the plug-in is the front-end postMessage solution. Therefore, transparent transmission of such environment variables is not currently supported.

In the future, we may think of a solution that allows such variables to be sent to the front end, and then communicated at the front end.

body:
@BrandonStudio 服务端 runtime 是 edge runtime ，这个能确保发出来的请求是贴近客户这一侧的，以及 stream 时长不超时。切到 node runtime 可以也可以，但是就是默认有 10s 时长限制。

我感觉这个根本上还是这个依赖的问题，应该推 azure 修才是。

----    
@BrandonStudio The server-side runtime is edge runtime, which ensures that the request sent is close to the client side and the stream duration does not time out. You can switch to node runtime, but there is a 10s time limit by default.

I feel that this is basically a dependency problem, and it should be repaired by Azure.

Doing some research on Google, I see that almost no one can get Docker to connect to Ollama. It appears to be an utterly hit and miss proposition.

`If you're experiencing connection issues, it’s often due to the WebUI docker container not being able to reach the Ollama server at 127.0.0.1:11434 (host.docker.internal:11434) inside the container . `

author: richardstevenhack

body:
I just solved the problem, as I described in bug 3064. I reproduce my comment there here:

I just had a similar problem with the Ragapp utility; wouldn't connect to Ollama via Docker. I just solved that problem a few minutes ago by doing this:

Based on an article on the Open-WebUI Github, they suggest:

`If you're experiencing connection issues, it’s often due to the WebUI docker container not being able to reach the Ollama server at 127.0.0.1:11434 (host.docker.internal:11434) inside the container . Use the --network=host flag in your docker command to resolve this. Note that the port changes from 3000 to 8080, resulting in the link: http://localhost:8080/.

Example Docker Command:

docker run -d --network=host -v open-webui:/app/backend/data -e OLLAMA_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:11434/ --name open-webui --restart always ghcr.io/open-webui/open-webui:main

`
What this does for open WebUI according to the Docker documentation is:

    --network=host set the Docker network to the host network (supposedly this only works on Linux.)
    Then the Ollama Base URL is set to Ollama's actual host URL.
    When this is done the port assignments are ignored, so it depends on what port the app is listening on. That appears to work fine with the port 8000 used by the Ragapp. You get a warning message from Docker that the port mappins are ignored.

So I executed this command for Lobe Chat:
docker run -d --network=host -p 3210:3210 -e OLLAMA_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:11434/ lobehub/lobe-chat

Then I entered the interface at port 3210, selected Ollama as the provider and left the Interface proxy address BLANK. The check passed, I went to the Just Chat, selected qwen2, and entered "Hi" as the message. I got the response from Qwen2.

I don't know if connecting Docker to the local host network is a security risk, but since I'm running on my own machine with the usual firewalls and the like, I don't really care. Your mileage may vary.

I'll also note that I'm running on openSUSE Tumbleweed Linux. For Windows or another Linux, your mileage may vary.

body:
I just had a similar problem with the Ragapp utility; wouldn't connect to Ollama via Docker. I just solved that problem a few minutes ago by doing this:

Based on an article on the Open-WebUI Github, they suggest:

`If you're experiencing connection issues, it’s often due to the WebUI docker container not being able to reach the Ollama server at 127.0.0.1:11434 (host.docker.internal:11434) inside the container . Use the --network=host flag in your docker command to resolve this. Note that the port changes from 3000 to 8080, resulting in the link: http://localhost:8080/.

Example Docker Command:

docker run -d --network=host -v open-webui:/app/backend/data -e OLLAMA_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:11434/ --name open-webui --restart always ghcr.io/open-webui/open-webui:main

`
What this does for open WebUI according to the Docker documentation is:
1) --network=host set the Docker network to the host network (supposedly this only works on Linux.)
2) Then the Ollama Base URL is set to Ollama's actual host URL.
3) When this is done the port assignments are ignored, so it depends on what port the app is listening on. That appears to work fine with the port 8000 used by the Ragapp. You get a warning message from Docker that the port mappins are ignored.

So I executed this command for Lobe Chat:
docker run -d --network=host -p 3210:3210 -e OLLAMA_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:11434 lobehub/lobe-chat

Then I entered the interface at port 3210, selected Ollama as the provider and left the Interface proxy address BLANK. The check passed, I went to the Just Chat, selected qwen2, and entered "Hi" as the message. I got the response from Qwen2.

I don't know if connecting Docker to the local host network is a security risk, but since I'm running on my own machine with the usual firewalls and the like, I don't really care. Your mileage may vary.

I'll also note that I'm running on openSUSE Tumbleweed Linux. For Windows or another Linux,  your mileage may vary.

### 🥰 Description of requirements

I would like to be able to add custom WebDAV synchronization capabilities to the Docker self-deployment version to achieve the following two main goals:

1Synchronize the web configuration deployed on the same machine.
2. "Best" can also synchronize the web configuration of different devices.

### 🧐 Solution

Develop WebDAV module: Based on the existing WebDAV protocol standard, develop a WebDAV module suitable for LobeChat. The module should support basic file upload, download, delete and update operations.
Design a configuration file management mechanism: Create a configuration file management mechanism that allows users to upload and download configuration files through the WebDAV server. This includes automatic detection of configuration changes, incremental update strategies, and conflict resolution mechanisms. Specific steps are as follows:
Initial synchronization: When the user connects to the WebDAV server for the first time, a full synchronization is performed and all relevant configuration files are downloaded locally.
Incremental update: During subsequent use, only the changed parts of the configuration file are synchronized to reduce the amount of data transfer and improve efficiency.
Conflict resolution: When multiple devices modify the same configuration file at the same time, the system should be able to intelligently handle conflicts and give reasonable solutions (such as prompting the user to choose which version of the changes to keep).
Integrated UI support: Adds settings options to the UI that allow users to enter information such as the WebDAV server's address, username, and password. At the same time, a manual synchronization button is provided so that users can manually trigger synchronization operations. Specific steps are as follows:
Settings Page: Create a new settings page or extend an existing settings page with all options related to WebDAV (such as server address, authentication information, etc.).
Manual synchronization button: Place a "Sync now" button or icon in a prominent position on the interface to facilitate users to initiate manual synchronization requests at any time. After clicking, the system will try to establish a connection with the specified WebDAV server and perform the corresponding synchronization operation (upload or download). If any errors are encountered (such as network problems, insufficient permissions, etc.), a friendly error message will be displayed to the user and guide them how to solve the problem (such as checking the network connection status, confirming whether the entered server address is correct, etc.).

不是不支持，是NEXT_PUBLIC_XXX变量必须在构建时就注入docker镜像，直接拉取官方镜像，在启动容器时设置NEXT_PUBLIC_XXX变量值是不可行的。

It's not that it's not supported, it's that the NEXT_PUBLIC_XXX variable must be injected into the docker image during construction. It is not feasible to directly pull the official image. It is not feasible to set the NEXT_PUBLIC_XXX variable value when starting the container.
Currently, if you want to use docker to run the cloud version of lobechat, you need to build the image yourself (declare and assign all environment variables required by the cloud version of lobechat in the dockerfile when building). Or after pulling the official image, it should be feasible to set new environment variables (build parameters) based on the official image and then build a new image.

你好啊，我让ai帮我理解了一下是这么个意思吗？

**已知情况**

> 需要在 Docker 构建时注入 NEXT_PUBLIC_ 环境变量。
> 直接使用官方镜像，并在运行时设置 NEXT_PUBLIC_ 变量是不可行的。
> 需要构建自定义的 Docker 镜像，并在构建时声明并赋值所有环境变量。

**当前问题**

> 如何在 Docker 构建时注入 NEXT_PUBLIC_ 环境变量。
> 确保自定义镜像可以在运行时正确工作。

**解决方案**

> 在 Dockerfile 中声明和设置环境变量：
> 使用 ARG 和 ENV 指令在 Dockerfile 中设置环境变量。
> 构建自定义 Docker 镜像：
> 使用 docker build 命令，在构建时传入环境变量值。
> 运行 Docker 容器：
> 确保其他非 NEXT_PUBLIC_ 变量在运行时通过 -e 选项传递。
>

author: innocentius

body:
I encountered the same issue. I set up a virtual LAN using ZeroTier.
Ollama is running on Host A, and LobeChat works normally on Host A. 

I have configured OLLAMA_HOST and OLLAMA_ORIGINS. On Host B, I can access `<Host A IP>:11434` using Chrome and receive the message "ollama is running". 
However, I cannot use LobeChat to access Ollama on Host A. I have tried closing the client fetch, but it did not work.

I used Wireshark on Host A to capture packets. When I accessed `<Host A IP>:11434` using Chrome on Host B, I could see the corresponding TCP packets. When I used LobeChat's check on Host A, I received the corresponding TCP and HTTP packets. However, when I used LobeChat's check on Host B, I did not receive any packets.

author: KingOfGitH

body:
> Bot detected the issue body's language is not English, translate it automatically. 👯👭🏻🧑‍🤝‍🧑👫🧑🏿‍🤝‍🧑🏻👩🏾‍🤝‍👨🏿👬🏿         
----    
Well, f12 took a look at the request. The cause of the problem is that the request was made directly from the client using the filled-in ollama address, instead of using the lobe-chat server access request, so the internal network segment of docker cannot be used.

---
### Task: Remove header field with Azure AI provider in error ✅

Successfully implemented a security fix to prevent API key exposure in Azure provider error responses.

#### Todo List:
- [x] Analyze the issue and understand the security problem
- [x] Find Azure AI provider implementation in the codebase
- [x] Locate error handling code that exposes request headers
- [x] Implement solution to sanitize sensitive headers
- [x] Test the changes
- [x] Run type checking and linting
- [x] Commit and push changes

#### What was done:

**Root Cause**: Both Azure providers (`azureOpenai` and `azureai`) were passing entire error objects from Azure/OpenAI SDKs to clients, which could include request details and headers containing API keys.

**Solution Implemented**:
1. **Created `sanitizeError` utility** (`packages/model-runtime/src/utils/sanitizeError.ts`):
   - Recursively removes sensitive fields like `request`, `headers`, `authorization`, `apikey`, etc.
   - Works with nested objects and arrays
   - Case-insensitive field detection
   - Comprehensive test coverage

2. **Updated Azure providers**:
   - `azureOpenai/index.ts`: Added sanitization in `handleError` method
   - `azureai/index.ts`: Added sanitization in error handling
   - Both now use `sanitizeError()` before sending errors to client

**Security Impact**: 
- ✅ API keys in request headers are now stripped from error responses
- ✅ Other sensitive fields (tokens, credentials, config) are also removed
- ✅ Error messages remain informative for debugging while protecting sensitive data
- ✅ Backwards compatible - no breaking changes to error structure

The fix ensures that when Azure model requests fail, sensitive information like API keys are not exposed to end users while maintaining useful error information for troubleshooting.

body:
> 另外你用 conda 是一个非常不标准的做法，你用 pnpm 就能隔离掉依赖了。要重装就删掉 `node_modules` ，然后 pnpm i 就好

额···我的理解是这样的，首先环境要安装 node,然后因为不同项目的问题，可能各自对 node 的版本依赖不同，比如有些老项目，就是不怎么折腾，太高的 node 版本反而不行。以前我是用 nvm 来管理，后来感觉没有 conda 方便。

其次用 pnpm 命令得先有 pnpm，而先有 pnpm 就得先有其他，比如说得先有 npm，用 npm 安装 pnpm～当然，可能还有其他的方式，这边只是举个例子。

顺着的你的建议思路，我期待的不只是“依赖”干净，也期望“环境”干净～让出现冲突或者版本不一致时，依赖好解决，重新-r 再指定一下依赖的版本之类的，一般都能解决，但是这些依赖又跟“环境版本”千丝万缕的关系，当“运行环境”版本都不合适时，最好是听项目作者的建议指定安装某个版本或不低于某个版本。毕竟，有些，变得很快····

所以，我才诞生了，用 conda 建立一个虚拟环境并指定安装某个项目作者建议的 python版本或 nodejs 版本，这样当出现环境上的问题，我可以快速的重来一遍，试错成本较低。

大概是以上一些浅薄的思路和想法···hhh···其实按目前流行的说话，docker 应该更能满足我对这方面的需求，说难听点就是这方面我多少有点洁癖···只是 docker 所消耗的硬件资源··确实目前来说有点吃不消···所以，有的选的时候，我还是想尽量折腾或捣鼓一下··看看有没有摸索到一个更适合的方法～～

body:
#3108 看下来应该是配置了一个自定义模型，首先使用了客户端请求；关闭客户端请求之后传入了一个不正确的模型名，传入了不支持的参数造成的报错。但从截图上看，至少网关是确定可以访问得到的。


参考#3254 其实并没有『国际专供』这一说，所以得排除下是否是网络环境的问题，得在部署的环境里测试下这两个endpoint能否curl得到：
`https://dashscope.aliyuncs.com/compatible-mode/v1/chat/completions`
`https://dashscope-intl.aliyuncs.com/compatible-mode/v1/chat/completions`
随便填API-KEY至少应该能拿到`invalid_api_key`

```
curl --location 'https://dashscope-intl.aliyuncs.com/compatible-mode/v1/chat/completions' \
--header 'Authorization: Bearer sk-xxx' \
--header 'Content-Type: application/json' \
--data '{
    "model": "qwen-plus",
    "messages": [
        {
            "role": "system",
            "content": "You are a helpful assistant."
        },
        {
            "role": "user",
            "content": "你是谁"
        }
    ],
    "stream": false
}'
```

--header 'Authorization: Bearer sk-xxx' \
--header 'Content-Type: application/json' \
--data '{
    "model": "qwen-plus",

        {
            "role": "system",
            "content": "You are a helpful assistant."

}'
```

body: ### 使用 Authing 身份认证提供者的配置方法 `Authing` 可以兼容 `Auth0`，但是是国内的服务，所以可以用微博、微信、QQ登录。 1. 注册 `Authing` ，新建一个 ToE 或者 ToC 用户池。 2. 在**身份源管理**页面增加**社会化身份源**。 3. 在**应用-自建应用**中，新建一个应用，此时可以看到如下图所示内容，你需要设置和保存**认证配置**，并根据生成的**端点信息**来配置 `lobehub` 的环境变量。 4. **配置要点：** - `NEXT_AUTH_SSO_PROVIDERS` 应设置为 `auth0` - `NEXTAUTH_URL` 和**Authing认证配置**中的**登录回调URL**并不是相同的。 `NEXTAUTH_URL` 应配置为 `https://{your-prod-domin}/api/auth` ，而**登录回调URL**应配置为 `https://{your-prod-domin}/api/auth/callback/auth0` - `AUTH0_ISSUER` 应设置为**端点信息**中的**Issuer**，不要删除结尾的/oidc

body: > ### 使用 Authing 身份认证提供者的配置方法 > `Authing` 可以兼容 `Auth0`，但是是国内的服务，所以可以用微博、微信、QQ登录。 > > 1. 注册 `Authing` ，新建一个 ToE 或者 ToC 用户池。 > 2. 在**身份源管理**页面增加**社会化身份源**。 > 3. 在**应用-自建应用**中，新建一个应用，此时可以看到如下图所示内容，你需要设置和保存**认证配置**，并根据生成的**端点信息**来配置 `lobehub` 的环境变量。 > > > 4. **配置要点：** > > * `NEXT_AUTH_SSO_PROVIDERS` 应设置为 `auth0` > * `NEXTAUTH_URL` 和**Authing认证配置**中的**登录回调URL**并不是相同的。 `NEXTAUTH_URL` 应配置为 `https://{your-prod-domin}/api/auth` ，而**登录回调URL**应配置为 `https://{your-prod-domin}/api/auth/callback/auth0` > * `AUTH0_ISSUER` 应设置为**端点信息**中的**Issuer**，不要删除结尾的/oidc Authing是不是要收费？

body:
> 首先非常感谢 @cy948 的努力，完成了 Next Auth 和 LobeChat 现有 Database 系统的集成，使得我们可以构建起 LobeChat 的服务端数据库的 Docker 镜像。
> 
> 服务端数据库的 docker 镜像已正式可用，镜像名为 `lobehub/lobe-chat-database`。
> 
> 关于服务端数据库的部署文档，详见： https://lobehub.com/docs/self-hosting/server-database
> 
> 在此也列出一个简版的部署指南，供大家参考。如有其他问题，欢迎在下方留言。
> 
> 1. 创建 pg 实例（注意：以下命令仅用于演示，因为这个 pg 实例并没有包含持久化部分，请自行构建一个符合你诉求的 生产级 pg 实例）
> 
> ```
> docker run --name my-postgres --network pg -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD=mysecretpassword -p 5432:5432 -d postgres
> ```
> 
> 2. 创建一个 `lobe-chat.env` 文件用于存放环境变量：
> 
> ```dotenv
> # DB 必须
> KEY_VAULTS_SECRET=jgwsK28dspyVQoIf8/M3IIHl1h6LYYceSYNXeLpy6uk=
> DATABASE_URL=postgres://postgres:mysecretpassword@my-postgres:5432/postgres
> 
> # NEXT_AUTH 相关
> NEXT_AUTH_SECRET=3904039cd41ea1bdf6c93db0db96e250
> NEXT_AUTH_SSO_PROVIDERS=auth0
> NEXTAUTH_URL=https://your-prod-domain.com/api/auth
> AUTH0_CLIENT_ID=xxxxxx
> AUTH0_CLIENT_SECRET=cSX_xxxxx
> AUTH0_ISSUER=https://lobe-chat-demo.us.auth0.com
> 
> # S3 相关
> S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID=xxxxxxxxxx
> S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=xxxxxxxxxx
> S3_ENDPOINT=https://xxxxxxxxxx.r2.cloudflarestorage.com
> S3_BUCKET=lobechat
> NEXT_PUBLIC_S3_DOMAIN=https://s3-for-lobechat.your-domain.com
> ```
> 
> 3. 启动 lobe-chat-database docker 镜像
> 
> ```shell
> docker run -it -d -p 3210:3210 --network pg --env-file lobe-chat.env --name lobe-chat-database lobehub/lobe-chat-database
> ```
> 
> 注意事项：确保数据库和 LobeChat DB 镜像在同一网络中

body:
> 发现有数据库字段冲突的问题，不太清楚是什么原因导致的冲突。

@morningtzh 可以看下这段迁移 sql ，https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/blob/main/src/database/server/migrations/0001_add_client_id.sql

这里的步骤是都会执行一遍的，如果你是用的db:push ，那么数据库里已经有 `client_id` 了，这里自然会冲突。

解决方案有两种：

1. 如果是完全从头自己建镜像，那么可以直接注释这一个文件中的所有 sql ，这样迁移脚本虽然会执行这个 sql 文件，但是由于里面是空的，所以会认为执行成功，这样就能进到下一个 sql 迁移脚本。如果还报错就继续用类似方法，直到全部执行完毕。
2. 删掉数据库重新部署一遍，这样应该不需要做什么操作直接就可以初始化完毕。

>  Dockerfile.database 镜像是否还兼容构建时传入clark参数用于登录

理论上应该是还支持的。你可以试下。

@morningtzh You can take a look at this migration sql, https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/blob/main/src/database/server/migrations/0001_add_client_id.sql

The steps here are all executed once. If you use db:push, then there is already `client_id` in the database, and there will naturally be a conflict here.

There are two solutions:

1. If you build the image completely from scratch, you can directly comment all the sql in this file. In this way, although the migration script will execute the sql file, it will be considered successful because it is empty, so you can enter Next sql migration script. If an error is still reported, continue using similar methods until all executions are completed.
2. Delete the database and redeploy it, so that the initialization can be completed without any operations.

> Is the Dockerfile.database image still compatible with the clark parameter passed in when building for login?

Theoretically it should be supported. You can try it.

body:
参考下这篇：https://alwq.xyz/post/2024-08-07-lobechat-database-deploy/
我在 NAS 通过 docker 部署，CF 做转发。

```
version: '3.8'

services:
  lobe-chat:
    image: lobehub/lobe-chat-database
    container_name: lobe-chat
    restart: always
    tty: true
    ports:
      - '3210:3210'
    env_file:
      - /share/data/lobechat/lobechat.env
    networks:
      - pg
    depends_on:
      - pg
      
  pg:
    image: postgres:latest
    restart: always
    tty: true
    env_file:
      - /share/data/lobechat/lobechat.env
    ports:
      - 5432:5432
    networks:
      - pg
    environment:
      PGUSER: ${PGUSER:-postgres}
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${POSTGRES_PASSWORD:-lobechat666}
      POSTGRES_DB: ${POSTGRES_DB:-lobechat}
      PGDATA: ${PGDATA:-/var/lib/postgresql/data/pgdata}
    volumes:
      - /share/data/lobechat/db/data:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "pg_isready"]
      interval: 1s
      timeout: 3s
      retries: 30

networks:
  pg:
    driver: bridge
```

body:
主要是现在判定就是不引入啊...

当 `PROXY_URL` 为空，则 `${PROXYCHAINS}` 为空，即 `${PROXYCHAINS} node "/app/server.js"` 等同于 `  node "/app/server.js"`

而且官方镜像，我在云函数平台（上海区域）中运行都正常的... 你要么先试试下面这个方法
```
dokcer pull lobehub/lobe-chat:latest

docker tag lobehub/lobe-chat:latest ${实例名称}.tencentcloudcr.com/${命名空间}/${名称}:[tag]

docker push ${实例名称}.tencentcloudcr.com/${命名空间}/${名称}:[tag]
```

你如果有顾虑你改成这个看看，逻辑等同:
```
CMD \
    if [ -n "$PROXY_URL" ]; then \
        # Set regex for IPv4
        IP_REGEX="^(25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|[01]?[0-9][0-9]?)(\.(25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|[01]?[0-9][0-9]?)){3}$"; \
        # Parse the proxy URL
        host_with_port="${PROXY_URL#*//}"; \
        host="${host_with_port%%:*}"; \
        port="${PROXY_URL##*:}"; \
        protocol="${PROXY_URL%%://*}"; \
        # Resolve to IP address if the host is a domain
        if ! [[ "$host" =~ "$IP_REGEX" ]]; then \
            nslookup=$(nslookup -q="A" "$host" | tail -n +3 | grep 'Address:'); \
            if [ -n "$nslookup" ]; then \
                host=$(echo "$nslookup" | tail -n 1 | awk '{print $2}'); \
            fi; \
        fi; \
        # Generate proxychains configuration file
        printf "%s\n" \
            'localnet 127.0.0.0/255.0.0.0' \
            'localnet ::1/128' \
            'proxy_dns' \
            'remote_dns_subnet 224' \
            'strict_chain' \
            'tcp_connect_time_out 8000' \
            'tcp_read_time_out 15000' \
            '[ProxyList]' \
            "$protocol $host $port" \
        > "/etc/proxychains/proxychains.conf"; \
        proxychains -q node "/app/server.js"; \
    else \
        node "/app/server.js"; \
    fi;
```

### 🐛 Problem description

When configuring Azure OpenAI, the default model used for connectivity check is: gpt-4o-mini. This is a bad behavior because the model naming rules of Azure OpenAI are not consistent with the model of Open AI. So if you click Connectivity Check, it will fail.

### 📷 Steps to reproduce

1. Model settings Azure OpenAI
2. Fill in the endpoint and Azure Api Version:2024-06-01
3. Fill in the custom model: gpt-35-turbo (this is how the azure ai model is named)
4. Click Connectivity Check, and an error will be reported. The reason is that gpt-4o-mini is used by default.

### 🚦 Expected results

For connectivity checks, gpt-4o-mini should not be used.
The plan is as follows:
1. Use the already populated model
2. Connectivity checks should indicate the model used

### 📝 Supplementary information

Azure Open Ai provides different models due to different regions. Japan does not even have 4o mini. After debugging for a long time, I found that this is the case. I hope that in addition to the error location, I can also see the model parameters used in the connectivity test next to it.

body:
> @briankwon path style 是啥？是 s3 标准的实现吗？

@arvinxx  path style和virtual host在s3是访问bucket和object的不同方式，URL 的结构和域名解析不太一样

假设minio的域名是minio.example.net，bucket为mybucket，object为config.env，具体区别如下：
path-style——minio.example.net/**mybucket**/config.env
virtual-host——**mybucket**.minio.example.net/config.env

可以发现bucket的位置是不同的，一个体现在path一个体现在域名，path-style在使用更简单，而virtual-host会涉及到部署反向代理解析等问题，对于个人使用有一定成本。

可以通过amazon s3 client初始化时控制是否激活path style，关于JavaScript SDK我找到了相关文档，[https://github.com/aws/aws-sdk-js-v3/blob/main/UPGRADING.md](url)
![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/c6953cfe-cbb3-4873-b3f1-bc66d6cc84fc)

> Bot detected the issue body's language is not English, translate it automatically. 👯👭🏻🧑‍🤝‍🧑👫🧑🏿‍🤝‍🧑🏻👩🏾‍🤝‍👨🏿👬🏿         
----    
> @briankwon What is path style? Is it an implementation of the s3 standard?

@arvinxx path style and virtual host are different ways to access buckets and objects in S3. The structure of the URL is different from the domain name resolution.

Assume that the domain name of minio is minio.example.net, the bucket is mybucket, and the object is config.env. The specific differences are as follows:
path-style——minio.example.net/**mybucket**/config.env
virtual-host——**mybucket**.minio.example.net/config.env

It can be found that the bucket locations are different. One is reflected in the path and the other is reflected in the domain name. Path-style is easier to use, while virtual-host will involve issues such as deploying reverse proxy resolution, which has a certain cost for personal use.

You can control whether to activate path style when initializing the amazon s3 client. I found relevant documents about JavaScript SDK, [https://github.com/aws/aws-sdk-js-v3/blob/main/UPGRADING.md]( url)

部署后能够上文文件到`s3`或兼容存储桶（如`minio` ），但遇到了前端报错：`NEXT_PUBLIC_S3_DOMAIN is not set while enable server upload`，原因是官方镜像build时就已经嵌入了前端代码，在容器运行时注入的环境变量只在后端生效。`next.js`的文档[Configuring: Environment Variables | Next.js (nextjs.org)](https://nextjs.org/docs/pages/building-your-application/configuring/environment-variables)：
> **By default, environment variables are only available on the server**. To expose an environment variable to the browser, it must be prefixed with `NEXT_PUBLIC_`. However, these public environment variables will be inlined into the JavaScript bundle during `next build`.

临时解决办法（workaround）：自行build镜像，build时就把自己的`NEXT_PUBLIC` 开头的环境变量打进去。

> 传入一个配置文件之类，或者直接从数据库读取

构建时变量和运行时变量的区别就是构建时变量是在构建阶段注入然后写死在构建产物里的，所以它没法在运行时灵活修改。

就先不用出其他主意了，这个问题我们会在知识库/文件上传的 feature 中修复掉的，耐心等待就好

----    
> Pass in a configuration file or the like, or read directly from the database

The difference between build-time variables and run-time variables is that build-time variables are injected during the build phase and hard-coded into the build product, so they cannot be flexibly modified at run time.

There is no need to come up with other ideas now. We will fix this problem in the knowledge base/file upload feature. Just wait patiently.

在`语言模型`中添加OPENAI的模型，使用HTTPS的地址会报错。使用HTTP则不会。

但我很纳闷，ONE-API会返回471 CODE，这是什么鬼。

然后我把NGINX里的配置改为公有证书则没问题，所以我认为是SSL的问题。

我看了下返回内容中有这个，我去搞下NGINX。

````
ERR_SSL_WRONG_VERSION_NUMBER
````

----

经过测试，TLSv1.0-1.3都不行。 

你好 @hezhijie0327 
测试了环境变量也不可以。

我目前发现不只是SSL的情况，是他不认协议……

----


总结：
1、 使用客户端模式没问题，因为自签证书在本机上有
2、 不使用客户端则不行，会出现使用的SSL协议错误问题 `"code": "ERR_SSL_WRONG_VERSION_NUMBER"` 和奇怪的CODE 471返回

目前已经找到解决办法了，就告知大家都使用客户端模式访问。感谢各位。

> Ability to create new topics

@arvinxx Can you consider adding this context clearing function? I have been using lobechat intensively for several weeks. It always feels weird without this context clearing function. It is also the only place where I feel uncomfortable using it.

It is possible to create a new topic, but this will make the topic very confusing. For example, if I ask an assistant to help me write programming homework questions, the questions are independent. I definitely hope that after asking each question, I can Clear the context to reduce token consumption, but if it only supports creating new topics, I can only ask a programming question and cut a new topic, so the topic list will be very large and confusing.

In this situation, having a context clearing function is undoubtedly more in line with the semantics of the word "topic"

author: RubuJam

body:
@icnahom as @RubuJam  said, the `chat-preview.lobehub.com` is a demo site for the self-hosting user. We don't suggest to use it in your daily usage.

The banner is not enabled in your own instance.

Maybe you don't know this demo site have a lots of traffic per months and we have to pay a lot for it. It's better for us that our open-source users can use their own instance other than the preview site.

It's a more healthy path for us to continued contribute to LobeChat like this:

1.  a new user to just visit the preview site and check whether LobeChat does he want.

2. if the user is a geek who know self-hosting a lot, he can use Vercel / Docker / Zeabur to deploy his instance for free. And then we don't need to pay the traffic fee for these users —— they afford by themself, and mostly are free.

3. If the user doesn't know self-hosting , he can try with our cloud version and decide to pay or not. 

In this way, we can guarantee the preview site can run for long-term, or it may be shut down due to high traffic fee.

### 🥰 Description of requirements

When uploading an image in the user dialog box, the image will be uploaded to S3 storage. However, if the user deletes the image before sending, the corresponding file in S3 will not be automatically deleted. Since the image is not displayed on the LobeChat client, the user cannot manually delete it from S3. As a result, these files will remain in S3 permanently, resulting in a waste of storage resources.

### 🧐 Solution

It is recommended that when users delete uploaded images (and file types that may be supported in the future), the corresponding storage files in S3 can be deleted simultaneously.

### 🐛 Bug Description

First I use the normal image `lobehub/lobe-chat:latest` and then set it in the environment variable
```
- NEXT_PUBLIC_SERVICE_MODE=server
- DATABASE_DRIVER=node
```
At this time, the table structure will not be automatically generated after startup. After logging in, the log prompts `error: relation "nextauth_accounts" does not exist` and no table structure is generated.

Next, I changed to a mirror `lobehub/lobe-chat-database:latest`. Something magical happened. This mirror automatically generated a table structure, and there was a prompt at the beginning of the log:
```
[Database] Start to migrate...
✅ database migration pass.
----------------------------------------

```
Before I was happy for a long time, this image prompted an error when I logged in.
```
[auth][error] TypeError: fetch failed

* Switch back to `lobehub/lobe-chat:latest` to use it normally

Both NextChat and Lobe are deployed on the same Vercel with the same Azure OpenAI endpoint and key ---

NextChat took nearly no time to render the chatbox:

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/7dd52306-0581-4d48-9a4d-f34634c0a2b3

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/386d2d30-14a2-40e0-b9d2-4fe4e4900165

P.S.
I’m not nitpicking, but due to NextChat's commercialization, the maintenance of the free version has become insufficient for our needs. Consequently, we are considering using Lobe for daily use. However, we've noticed that Lobe's frontend performance could use some improvements. Enhancing the loading speed, responsiveness, and resource management would significantly enhance our user experience.

body:
Beside, If your using Clerk as Auth provider, there will be a more long time (~2s) to init clerk auth depending on your network.

If you don't need data sync, the client db mode will be much faster than server db mode. In current stage, the cost of cloud data sync is a little bit slow of page loading. In the futher, the network slow connection may be solved by local-first refactor and Desktop application.

But it all depends on your demand.

body:
关于`minio`，有一个`workaround`方案。
```env
NEXT_PUBLIC_S3_DOMAIN=https://second.first.top:port/bucket-name
S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID=...
S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=...
S3_ENDPOINT=https://first.top:port/bucket-name
S3_BUCKET=second
```
就是说，在`S3_`开头的环境变量中，刻意把二级域名和桶名称调换下，颇有偷天换日的感觉。

body:
<!-- Greeting -->
Hey @nexusdiscord! I'm here to help you with any bugs, questions, or contributions you have while waiting for a human maintainer. Let's tackle this together!

<!-- Answer -->
The error message "invalid byte sequence for encoding 'UTF8': 0x00" indicates that the file contains invalid UTF-8 byte sequences, which is causing the chunking process to fail.

To address this issue, you can try the following steps:

1. **Check File Encoding**: Ensure that the file is properly encoded in UTF-8. You can use tools like `iconv` or text editors that support encoding conversion to re-encode the file.

2. **Handle Non-UTF-8 Encodings**: Modify the chunking process to handle files with different encodings. This might involve detecting the file encoding and converting it to UTF-8 before processing.

3. **Update Chunking Logic**: If the chunking logic does not currently handle non-UTF-8 encodings, you may need to update it. This can be done in the `ContentChunk` class, specifically in the `chunkContent` method, to include encoding detection and conversion.

Here is a relevant part of the `ContentChunk` class where you might need to make changes:

```ts
async chunkContent(params: ChunkContentParams): Promise<ChunkResult> {
  // Detect and convert encoding to UTF-8 if necessary
  const content = convertToUTF8(params.content);

  if (this.isUsingUnstructured(params))
    return await this.chunkByUnstructured(params.filename, content);

  return await this.chunkByLangChain(params.filename, content);
}

function convertToUTF8(content: Uint8Array): Uint8Array {
  // Implement encoding detection and conversion logic here
  // For example, using the 'iconv-lite' library
  const iconv = require('iconv-lite');
  const detectedEncoding = detectEncoding(content); // Implement this function
  return iconv.encode(iconv.decode(content, detectedEncoding), 'utf-8');
}
```

By implementing encoding detection and conversion, you can ensure that the chunking process handles files with different encodings correctly.

For more details on the chunking process, you can refer to the `ContentChunk` class in the `src/server/modules/ContentChunk/index.ts` file <sup>[[1]](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/blob/main/src/server/modules/ContentChunk/index.ts)</sup>.

> Have chats saved into a Mysql database. Connection settings (ip/url, password, port, databasename) can be configured with ENV variables.

Officially we won't support mysql /SQLite. MySQL or SQLite don't have pgvector plugin as Postgres does. It means these two db can't work with embedding semantic search, which is the core part of RAG (technique behind file chat or knowledge base chat).

> I also don't want to purchase an S3 server. 

you can also deploy pg on your own local computer, and use self-hosting S3 solution like [minio](https://min.io). Here is a demo example that you can run LobeChat DB on your local PC or Mac: https://lobehub.com/docs/self-hosting/server-database/docker#using-locally-mac-windows

> Unfortunately, the docker-compose documentation that could automate this procedure doesn't exist yet.

We are working on this. You may need to wait for several days to let us finish it.

1. If the network is convulsed In this case, "Unable to connect to the plug-in store" will be displayed here, and the error window "session not found" will pop up)

2. As shown in #3565, if the uploaded file name is relatively long, the web page will become horizontally scrollable. The page must be scrolled horizontally to see the complete file name and check mark (in fact, even if the file name can be displayed completely on one screen, it will trigger horizontal scrolling of the web page, and the file upload box will scroll with the horizontal movement)

3. If the uploaded file name is relatively long, when viewing the file details, the file name will be displayed vertically on the left, with only one word in each row, and the preview page will also be displayed vertically under the file name, resulting in an extremely long page. There are many blank areas, which seriously affects the experience.
   And when you click the return button in the upper left corner of the file details page, you will return to the file-manage your files and knowledge base page. You need to use Safari's left swipe back gesture to return to the chat interface.
  It is also recommended that the file details page provide a button to copy the file link just like the desktop website.

4. (Continued from 3) The interaction of knowledge base file management is a bit rough. It seems that the mobile terminal has not yet entered the entrance similar to the knowledge base management page of the desktop website, but pressing the operation in (3) will jump to the knowledge base management interface, but the management function It's not perfect yet, (at least when accessed by iPhone Safari, you can only create, rename, and delete knowledge bases)

body:
> 1.在没有上传文件的情况下，点击随便聊聊的输入框工具栏里的文件/知识库按钮，会显示“暂无已安装插件”（不知道这个功能和插件有什么联系，如果网络抽风的情况下，这里会显示“无法连接到插件商店”，弹出报错窗口“session not found”）

代码是插件模块拷过来的，这部分异常忘记处理了，我优化下

> 2.如 https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/issues/3565 所示，如果上传的文件名比较长，网页就会变成可以横向滚动。必须横向滚动页面才能看到完整文件名和选中标志（实际上，就算文件名可以在一个屏幕中显示完全，也会触发网页横向滚动，文件上传框随横向移动而滚动）

这个也一并优化

> 3.如果上传的文件名比较长，查看该文件详情时，文件名会在左侧竖排显示，每一排只有一个字，预览页面也在文件名下竖排，导致页面特别长，右侧空白区域多，严重影响体验。

这个能截个图看下吗？没太理解


> 4.（续3）知识库文件管理交互有点粗糙，似乎移动端目前还没有进入类似于桌面网站知识库管理页面的入口，但按（3）中操作会跳入知识库管理界面，但管理功能还没有完善，（至少在iphone safari访问时，只能创建、重命名、删除知识库）

粗糙在哪，具体说说？ 知识库管理的移动端一期没做，工作量太大了。另外其实我想不太到什么场景下需要在移动端管理知识库？要上传的文件难道都存在手机里么？我自己感觉移动端只是消费场景，没有太大必要做知识库管理。

> 5.在聊天界面上传文件并（在同界面）删除后，知识库按钮唤起的文件（知识库）列表不会同步删除，此时若选中已删除的文件，会报错

这个应该是个 bug ，后续修复。

我理解的随便聊聊的逻辑和助手不太一样，我认为随便聊聊的目的是提供一个空白模板让用户进行全新的对话（每次对话后如果我认为这次会话有保留的价值我会选择保存为对话），保存的对话/助手保留/附加这个文件的背景知识是合理的。

但目前的情况是，我在随便聊聊中上传一个文件并选中为知识库，对话结束后我选择将此对话保存为会话。但下一次打开随便聊聊时，仍然默认选中该文件为知识库。我认为这是不合适的，因为使用随便聊聊时我期待的是一次全新的对话（“随便”）；如果我希望仍然在上一次上传的文件背景知识下对话，我会选择继续上一次会话or新建/使用一个指定该文件为知识库的助手。

在开始（随便聊聊）会话的时候，没什么问题，因为”文件上传后在聊天框上方显示的文件信息“可以提示用户这个会话与文件关联了。

所以我觉得，（至少在随便聊聊中），上传文件后应该自动关联该文件，给出该文件知识已经被应用到该对话的强提示（对话上方模型名旁边有”该文件和知识库标志“）；也方便（随便聊聊）会话保存为对话后，直观地看到该对话关联的”文件/知识库“情况。

另外，对于”你自己多选了一步当然就是在整个助手维度生效了啊。“ 
 ”我理解的随便聊聊的逻辑和助手不太一样“，对于一般助手来说，多选一步就对整个助手生效，是合理的；因为我新建/编辑一个助手就是想固定一个包含知识库/文件选择的聊天范式。

如果我希望仍然在上一次上传的文件背景知识下对话，我会选择从已保存的会话中继续对话or手动在随便聊聊知识库工具栏中选中该文件继续”随便聊聊“or新建/使用一个指定该文件为知识库的助手。

body: > > 但当这个会话自动保存为对话后，”文件上传后在聊天框上方显示的文件信息“会消失，知识库工具栏中也会显示这个文件没有被选中，（桌面端）对话上方模型名旁边也没有”该文件和知识库标志“；虽然实际对话中还是可以使用该文件的知识，但上述表现也许会误导用户这个对话没有应用文件知识。而且也需要翻阅聊天记录才能知道在首次会话时上传、关联了哪些文件。 > > 这个能截个图看下么？正常上传之后在消息上有附着的文件的。我理解有这个应该就能很清楚地显示出来是基于这个文件的对话吧 > > 这就是我所说的”需要翻阅聊天记录才能知道在首次会话时上传、关联了哪些文件“，如果对话很短就还好一眼就看得见。 如果对话比较长，就不太直观和方便，就要滚动到最开始的会话记录才看得到（而且如果我不是在对话开始一次性上传所有文件，而是在不同对话阶段分次上传对话所需文件，那就要从头翻到尾才能知道这个会话里关联了哪些文件——还不能翻快了，我的经验是如果聊天比较长，滚动浏览会话记录就不能太快，不然就会不流畅或者滚动过程中会话显示不全，要停下来等一会才能显示完全）。 所以我觉得随便聊聊中上传文件后自动关联文件（这样在保存为会话后，无论对话长短，对话框上方模型名旁、对话框知识库工具栏中就能很直观地看到/调整文件关联情况），对话保存为会话后，对话和知识库配置清空是比较好的做法。

And you also need to look through the chat history to know which files were uploaded and associated during the first conversation. > > Can you take a screenshot of this? After normal upload, there will be files attached to the message. I understand that this should be able to clearly show that the dialogue is based on this file. > > This is what I mean by "you need to look through the chat history to know which files were uploaded and associated during the first conversation." If the conversation is short, you can see it at a glance. If the conversation is relatively long, it is not very intuitive and convenient. You have to scroll to the very beginning of the conversation record to see it (and if I do not upload all the files at once at the beginning of the conversation, but upload the conversation required in different stages of the conversation. file, then you have to scroll through the conversation from beginning to end to know which files are associated with this conversation - you can't scroll quickly yet. My experience is that if the chat is long, you can't scroll through the conversation record too fast, otherwise it will not be smooth or The session is not fully displayed during scrolling, and you have to stop and wait for a while before it is fully displayed). So I think that after uploading a file in a casual chat, the file will be automatically associated (so that after saving as a session, regardless of the length of the session, you can intuitively see/adjust the file association next to the model name at the top of the dialog box and in the knowledge base toolbar of the dialog box) situation), it is a good practice to clear the conversation and knowledge base configuration after saving the conversation as a session.

body:
> 所以我觉得随便聊聊中上传文件后自动关联文件（这样在保存为会话后，无论对话长短，对话框上方模型名旁、对话框知识库工具栏中就能很直观地看到/调整文件关联情况），对话保存为会话后，对话和知识库配置清空是比较好的做法。

首先随便聊聊也是助手。只是目前名字起的是「随便聊聊」而已。未来这个可能也会允许你自定义头像和名字（比如改成 贾维斯/ 多来 A 梦 这种）。所以不太可能让这个助手和其他助手有非常大的交互差异。

然后再说你的问题，其实本质上是在对话中不是很方便看到当前的文档信息，合理的解法应该是有一个地方可以直接展示当前上下文中的所有媒体文件。这个可以有其他优化方案，但不应该是去在助手顶部 tag 中展示。

First of all, just chatting casually is also an assistant. It’s just that the current name is “Just Chat.” In the future, this may also allow you to customize your avatar and name (for example, changing it to Jarvis/Doraemon). So it is unlikely that this assistant will have a very large interaction difference with other assistants.

Then let’s talk about your problem. In fact, it is actually not very convenient to see the current document information in the conversation. The reasonable solution should be to have a place that can directly display all the media files in the current context. There can be other optimization solutions for this, but it should not be displayed in the tag at the top of the assistant.

### 🥰 Description of requirements

At present, LobeChat's file management function is already very useful, but it still lacks an important function - file renaming. Adding this feature can greatly improve users' flexibility and efficiency in managing files.

### 🧐 Solution

Desired features:
1. In the file list, add a "Rename" option for each file.
2. After clicking "Rename", the user is allowed to enter a new file name.
3. After saving the new file name, the system should immediately update the file list to display the new file name.
4. The rename operation should be synchronized to the back-end storage to ensure the persistence of the file name.

Technical considerations:
- Need to add renaming functionality in front-end UI
- The backend API needs to support file renaming operations
- Need to consider the handling mechanism of file name conflicts

### 📝 Supplementary information

最近稍微研究了下 MinIO，至少功能正常，可以参考下

1. Docker 部署
```
DOCKER_PATH="/docker/minio" # 改为你的数据存储路径
SSL_PATH="/docker/ssl" # 改为你的 SSL 证书路径

docker run --name minio --restart=always \
    -e MINIO_ROOT_USER="minioadmin" \
    -e MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD="minioadmin" \
    -e MINIO_DOMAIN="oss.example.com" \
    -e MINIO_REGION="us-east-1" \ # 非必要
    -e MINIO_SERVER_URL="https://oss.example.com:9000" \ # 非必要
    -e MINIO_BROWSER_REDIRECT_URL="https://console.example.com:9001" \ # 非必要
    -p 9000:9000/tcp \
    -p 9001:9001/tcp \
    -v ${SSL_PATH}/fullchain.cer:/etc/minio/cert/public.crt:ro \ # 非必要
    -v ${SSL_PATH}/example.com.key:/etc/minio/cert/private.key:ro \ # 非必要
    -v ${DOCKER_PATH}/data:/etc/minio/data \
    -d minio/minio:latest \
    server "/etc/minio/data" \
    --address ":9000" \
    --console-address ":9001" \
    --certs-dir "/etc/minio/cert" # 非必要
```
2. 访问 console 地址，如：https://IP:9001 或 https://console.example.com:9001 并登录

### 🥰 Description of requirements

Thanks to the author team for providing such a beautiful, simple, and excellent third-party web page! Lobe with its knowledge base is undoubtedly one of the most powerful open source AI chat web pages currently!
Considering that the traffic price of S3 storage is relatively high, I am worried that some users may upload too large files or use the lobe as a cloud disk. Therefore, I hope to add environment variables to limit the total size of files uploaded by a single user, as well as the number of files uploaded in a single time. size threshold.

### 🧐 Solution

Add environment variables

_No response_

body:
单次文件上传的大小限制感觉在 S3 服务里有的吧。是不是直接配置下就好了？

> 限制单个用户已上传文件的总大小

这个应该不会计划在开源版里做，毕竟我们的开源版面向的群体是个人用户私有化部署。而你提到的这个特性属于管理端的需求了，做了吃力不讨好…

未来如果真要做的话，也只会考虑在付费镜像里做吧

The size limit for a single file upload seems to exist in the S3 service. Is it just a matter of configuring it directly?

> Limit the total size of uploaded files by a single user

This should not be planned to be done in the open source version. After all, our open source version is aimed at privatized deployment by individual users. The feature you mentioned belongs to the needs of the management side, and it is thankless to do it...

If I really want to do it in the future, I will only consider doing it in a paid mirror.

<!-- Greeting -->
@chung1912 你好！我是[Dosu](https://dosu.dev)，一个能够帮助你解决bug、回答问题并成为贡献者的机器人。我会在等待人类维护者的时候帮助你。

<!-- Answer -->
I found a similar closed issue: [[Bug] 上传文件分块失败](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/issues/3545). The issue was resolved by adding a layer of internal authentication during deployment, which caused the server's RPC call to fail. The specific solution involved configuring the `APP_URL` to ensure that the server program could access it directly, bypassing any additional authentication layers.

For your specific issue with the "[TaskTimeout]: chunking task is timeout, please try again" error when uploading a PDF file, you need to increase the `ASYNC_TASK_TIMEOUT` value. This value determines the maximum time allowed for the chunking task to complete before it times out.

In the provided code, the `ASYNC_TASK_TIMEOUT` is used in a `setTimeout` function to reject the task if it takes too long:

```ts
const timeoutPromise = new Promise((_, reject) => {
  setTimeout(() => {
    reject({
      body: { detail: 'chunking task is timeout, please try again' },
      name: AsyncTaskErrorType.Timeout,
    } as AsyncTaskError);
  }, ASYNC_TASK_TIMEOUT);
});
```

To increase the timeout, locate the `ASYNC_TASK_TIMEOUT` definition in your configuration and set it to a higher value. For example, if it is currently set to 30000 milliseconds (30 seconds), you might increase it to 60000 milliseconds (60 seconds) or more, depending on your needs.

Here is an example of how you might change the timeout value:

```ts
const ASYNC_TASK_TIMEOUT = 60000; // Increase timeout to 60 seconds

Windows

### 🐛 Problem description

Currently, the NEXTAUTH+logto/auth0 used in deploying the db version has the problem of clicking to log out and logging in again without entering any verification information. This is relatively unsafe. For example, when you use an office computer to log in to the lobe at work, log out after use, and the next user directly clicks to log in. You can get the login status without entering anything.

### 📷 Steps to reproduce

NEXTAUTH+logto/auth0 deployment
- Log in normally
- Click on the avatar to log out
- Log in again (the login status of the authentication platform is not logged out at this time)

### 🚦 Expected results

After the user logs out, he completely logs out of all login status, session, etc. in the authentication service and other places.

@ZeroDeng01 你好，我是[Dosu](https://dosu.dev)。我是一个可以帮助您解决错误、回答问题并成为贡献者的机器人。我会在等待人类维护者的过程中帮助您。

<!-- Answer -->
要确保用户在退出登录后完全注销所有认证服务和会话状态，可以按照以下步骤进行配置和实现：

1. **删除会话**：确保在用户退出时，删除所有会话和令牌。可以使用以下代码片段来删除会话：

```ts
async deleteSession(sessionToken): Promise<AdapterSession | null | undefined> {
  await serverDB
    .delete(nextauthSessions)
    .where(eq(nextauthSessions.sessionToken, sessionToken));
  return;
}
```

2. **删除用户（可选）**：如果需要完全删除用户及其所有相关数据，可以调用 `deleteUser` 方法：

```ts
async deleteUser(id): Promise<AdapterUser | null | undefined> {
  const user = await UserModel.findById(id);
  if (!user) throw new Error('NextAuth: Delete User not found');
  await UserModel.deleteUser(id);
  return;
}
```

3. **完整的注销函数**：实现一个完整的注销函数，确保在用户退出时调用 `deleteSession` 和 `deleteUser` 方法，并调用 `next-auth` 的 `signOut` 方法：

```ts
import { signOut } from 'next-auth/react';

async function completeLogout(sessionToken, userId) {
  // 删除会话
  await deleteSession(sessionToken);

  // 可选：删除用户
  await deleteUser(userId);

  // 调用 next-auth 的 signOut 方法
  await signOut();
}
```

4. **环境变量配置**：确保在 Docker 环境中正确配置了 NextAuth 的环境变量：

- `NEXT_AUTH_SECRET`: 用于加密 Auth.js 会话令牌的密钥。
- `NEXTAUTH_URL`: 执行 OAuth 验证时 Auth.js 的回调地址。
- `NEXT_AUTH_SSO_PROVIDERS`: 启用多个身份验证源，使用逗号分隔（例如 `auth0,azure-ad,authentik`）。

通过以上步骤，可以确保用户在退出登录后完全注销所有认证服务和会话状态，提升安全性<sup>[[1]](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/blob/main/src/libs/next-auth/adapter/index.ts)</sup><sup>[[2]](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/blob/main/src/store/user/slices/auth/action.test.ts)</sup><sup>[[3]](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/blob/main/docs/self-hosting/advanced/auth.mdx)</sup>.

非常感谢你提供的文档和建议。但很抱歉个人暂不考虑该需求的实现，理由如下：

- **问题验证**：Logto在web页面登录时会使用一个cookie用于保持在web页面的登录状态，当App登陆时重定向至Logto授权页面时，会直接携带该cookie进行访问从而实现“免验证登录”。清除该Cookie后不会产生该问题。属于logto授权页面的session；
- **维护范围**：当前实现基于 NextAuth 的登录方案已在登出时注销所有与本 APP 相关的会话。Logto 页面的会话不在维护域内，应该由用户及Logto进行维护及管理；
- **使用习惯建议**：若在公用的电脑进行登录，则应该使用隐私窗口保护隐私。若在非公用电脑上登录，一段时间的“免验证登录”则能提供便利，不需要主动去注销该session。

对于您所提到的实现，可以关注后续看看社区有无相关贡献者实现该需求。此处给出一些可能的关键文件：
- NextAuth 配置位置： https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/blob/main/src/libs/next-auth/auth.config.ts
- Logto 配置位置： https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/blob/main/src/libs/next-auth/sso-providers/logto.ts
- LobeChat 前端执行 signOut 的 hook: https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/blob/24dd3c88766bb576fe30b9b2f8c5228b183e33a1/src/store/user/slices/auth/action.ts#L29

----    
Thank you very much for the documentation and advice. But I am sorry that I will not consider the realization of this requirement for the time being. The reasons are as follows:

- **Problem verification**: Logto will use a cookie to maintain the login status of the web page when logging in. When the App redirects to the Logto authorization page when logging in, it will directly carry the cookie for access to achieve " Login without verification." This problem will not occur after clearing the cookie. The session belonging to the logto authorization page;
- **Maintenance Scope**: The current implementation of the NextAuth-based login scheme has logged out all sessions related to this APP when logging out. The session of the Logto page is not in the maintenance domain and should be maintained and managed by the user and Logto;
- **Usage Tips**: If you log in on a public computer, you should use a privacy window to protect your privacy. If you log in on a non-public computer, a period of "verification-free login" can provide convenience, and there is no need to actively log out of the session.

For the implementation you mentioned, you can follow up to see if there are relevant contributors in the community to implement this requirement. Some possible key files are given here:
- NextAuth configuration location: https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/blob/main/src/libs/next-auth/auth.config.ts
- Logto configuration location: https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/blob/main/src/libs/next-auth/sso-providers/logto.ts

@VectorZhao 这个和是否登录没有关系。因为目前我们并没有集成 logto 的 webhooks ，因此当在 logto 上修改用户信息时，lobe 的数据库里并没有接收到 logto 的修改信息，因此用户的头像还是原来的。这个要解决的话等 #3774 实现

This has nothing to do with whether you are logged in or not. Because we currently do not integrate logto's webhooks, when the user information is modified on logto, the logto modification information is not received in the lobe database, so the user's avatar remains the original. If this needs to be solved, wait until #3774 is implemented.

body:
<!-- Answer -->
要解决在 PWA 客户端中分享会话截图时，内容中的图片区域变成灰色的问题，请确保在截图前所有图片都已完全加载。可以通过在调用截图函数前等待所有图片加载完成来实现。

以下是更新后的 `handleDownload` 函数，它会等待图片加载完成：

```ts
const handleDownload = useCallback(async () => {
  setLoading(true);
  try {
    let screenshotFn: any;
    switch (imageType) {
      case ImageType.JPG: {
        screenshotFn = domToJpeg;
        break;
      }
      case ImageType.PNG: {
        screenshotFn = domToPng;
        break;
      }
      case ImageType.SVG: {
        screenshotFn = domToSvg;
        break;
      }
      case ImageType.WEBP: {
        screenshotFn = domToWebp;
        break;
      }
    }

    const images = document.querySelectorAll('#preview img');
    const imagePromises = Array.from(images).map((img) => {
      return new Promise((resolve) => {
        if (img.complete) {
          resolve(true);
        } else {
          img.onload = () => resolve(true);
          img.onerror = () => resolve(true);
        }
      });
    });

    await Promise.all(imagePromises);

    const dataUrl = await screenshotFn(document.querySelector('#preview') as HTMLDivElement, {
      features: {
        // 不启用移除控制符，否则会导致 safari emoji 报错
        removeControlCharacter: false,
      },
      scale: 2,
    });
    const link = document.createElement('a');
    link.download = `LobeChat_${title}_${dayjs().format('YYYY-MM-DD')}.${imageType}`;
    link.href = dataUrl;
    link.click();
    setLoading(false);
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Failed to download image', error);
    setLoading(false);
  }
}, [imageType, title]);
```

这段代码确保在 `#preview` 元素中的所有图片加载完成后再进行截图，从而解决图片区域变灰的问题 <sup>[[1]](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/blob/main/src/app/(main)/chat/(workspace)/features/ShareButton/useScreenshot.ts)</sup>.

Is it possible to add custom model configurations to the non-standard models obtained automatically, so that some models will not automatically add certain functions but can be added manually. A custom model configuration button is also added to non-standard named models to allow users to customize the model configuration themselves.

Provides a deployment mode that allows us to use a
Simple and lightweight front-end interface.

When the graphics acceleration function is not turned on in the Edge browser, the big-headed man animation in the default interface of lobechat can occupy 70% of the CPU.
![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/016b150c-d97d-41d0-b16f-e792b9ad9860)

This is a big burden for some devices with poor performance. I wonder if there are other situations that significantly affect performance and if this is one of the reasons for the poor performance of accessing lobechat from mobile devices.
Personally, I think the core functions of lobechat can be run on a front end without fancy special effects. Is it possible to provide a deployment mode that allows us to use a
Simple and lightweight front-end interface.

Is it possible to cancel some animation and decorative effects?

<!-- Greeting -->
@Borber 你好！我是[Dosu](https://dosu.dev)，我是一个可以帮助你解决 bug、回答问题并成为贡献者的机器人。我会在等待人类维护者的时候帮助你。 

<!-- Answer -->
I found a similar closed issue: [[Bug] Uncaught TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/issues/1227), which was resolved by a pull request that fixed a missing error related to non-HTTPS `crypto.subtle` <sup>[[1]](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/issues/1227)</sup>.

For your specific issue with the first message not carrying an image, the system handles the first message differently by checking if it is a welcome question and by potentially creating a new topic if certain conditions are met. This might be affecting the image attachment process. Here is the relevant code snippet:

```ts
export interface SendMessageParams {
  message: string;
  files?: UploadFileItem[];
  onlyAddUserMessage?: boolean;
  isWelcomeQuestion?: boolean;
}

sendMessage: async ({ message, files, onlyAddUserMessage, isWelcomeQuestion }) => {
  const { internal_coreProcessMessage, activeTopicId, activeId } = get();
  if (!activeId) return;

  const fileIdList = files?.map((f) => f.id);
  const hasFile = !!fileIdList && fileIdList.length > 0;

  if (!message && !hasFile) return;

  set({ isCreatingMessage: true }, false, 'creatingMessage/start');

  const newMessage: CreateMessageParams = {
    content: message,
    files: fileIdList,
    role: 'user',
    sessionId: activeId,
    topicId: activeTopicId,
  };

  const agentConfig = getAgentChatConfig();

  let tempMessageId: string | undefined = undefined;
  let newTopicId: string | undefined = undefined;

  if (!onlyAddUserMessage && !activeTopicId && agentConfig.enableAutoCreateTopic) {
    const chats = chatSelectors.currentChats(get());
    const featureLength = chats.length + 2;

    if (!get().activeTopicId && featureLength >= agentConfig.autoCreateTopicThreshold) {
      tempMessageId = get().internal_createTmpMessage(newMessage);
      get().internal_toggleMessageLoading(true, tempMessageId);

      const topicId = await get().createTopic();

      if (topicId) {
        newTopicId = topicId;
        newMessage.topicId = topicId;
        const mapKey = chatSelectors.currentChatKey(get());
        const newMaps = {
          ...get().messagesMap,
          [messageMapKey(activeId, topicId)]: get().messagesMap[mapKey],
        };
        set({ messagesMap: newMaps }, false, 'internal_copyMessages');
        get().internal_toggleMessageLoading(false, tempMessageId);
        get().internal_updateTopicLoading(topicId, true);
      }
    }
  }

  useSessionStore.getState().triggerSessionUpdate(get().activeId);

  const id = await get().internal_createMessage(newMessage, {
    tempMessageId,
    skipRefresh: !onlyAddUserMessage,
  });

  if (!!newTopicId) {
    await get().switchTopic(newTopicId, true);
    await get().internal_fetchMessages();
    const newMaps = { ...get().messagesMap, [messageMapKey(activeId, null)]: [] };
    set({ messagesMap: newMaps }, false, 'internal_copyMessages');
  }

  if (onlyAddUserMessage) {
    set({ isCreatingMessage: false }, false, 'creatingMessage/start');
    return;
  }

  const messages = chatSelectors.currentChats(get());
  const userFiles = chatSelectors.currentUserFiles(get()).map((f) => f.id);

  await internal_coreProcessMessage(messages, id, {
    isWelcomeQuestion,
    ragQuery: get().internal_shouldUseRAG() ? message : undefined,
  });

  set({ isCreatingMessage: false }, false, 'creatingMessage/stop');

  const summaryTitle = async () => {
    if (!agentConfig.enableAutoCreateTopic) return;
    if (newTopicId) {
      const chats = chatSelectors.currentChats(get());
      await get().summaryTopicTitle(newTopicId, chats);
      return;
    }

    const topic = topicSelectors.currentActiveTopic(get());

    if (topic && !topic.title) {
      const chats = chatSelectors.currentChats(get());
      await get().summaryTopicTitle(topic.id, chats);
    }
  };

  const addFilesToAgent = async () => {
    if (userFiles.length === 0 || !isServerMode) return;
    await useAgentStore.getState().addFilesToAgent(userFiles, false);
  };

  await Promise.all([summaryTitle(), addFilesToAgent()]);
},
```

Additionally, there are error logs and debug messages generated when an image attachment fails, which can help in diagnosing the issue:

```json
{
  "upload": {
    "desc": "Details: {{detail}}",
    "fileOnlySupportInServerMode": "The current deployment mode does not support uploading non-image files. To upload files in {{ext}} format, please switch to server database deployment or use LobeChat Cloud service.",
    "networkError": "Please check your network connection and ensure that the file storage service's cross-origin configuration is correct.",
    "title": "File upload failed. Please check your network connection or try again later",
    "unknownError": "Error reason: {{reason}}",
    "uploadFailed": "File upload failed."
  }
}
```

These logs indicate various reasons for the failure, such as network errors, unsupported file types, and general upload failures <sup>[[2]](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/blob/main/locales/en-US/error.json)</sup><sup>[[3]](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/blob/main/src/app/api/text-to-image/[provider]/route.ts)</sup><sup>[[4]](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/blob/main/src/store/chat/slices/builtinTool/action.ts)</sup>.

body: 这个 JWT 抛错的含义是， payload 鉴权 token 过期。你看到的 100s 是指过期时间是 100s。 建议你检查下你的本地 docker 镜像的时区是否是和你电脑一致的。如果时区不一致是有可能导致这个问题的。 ----- 纯 HTTP 访问正常的原因是在构造 JWT 时 http 模式下会不做加密直接 base64 一下传递，服务端解析的时候针对 http 的场景是用的另外一套验证逻辑

The 100s you see means the expiration time is 100s. It is recommended that you check whether the time zone of your local docker image is consistent with that of your computer. This problem may occur if the time zones are inconsistent. ----- The reason why pure HTTP access is normal is that when constructing JWT, it will be directly passed through base64 without encryption in http mode. When the server parses, another set of verification logic is used for the http scenario.

body:
<!-- Answer -->
要解决在 Docker 上的 Windows 环境中使用 Chrome 浏览器时更新本地插件时出现的 "duplicate key value violates unique constraint" 错误，请确保 `user_installed_plugins` 表中的 `identifier` 字段是唯一的。此错误是由于尝试插入或更新具有唯一约束的列中的重复值而引起的。

`user_installed_plugins` 表的结构如下：

- **user_id**: `text`, not null
- **identifier**: `text`, not null
- **type**: `text`, not null
- **manifest**: `jsonb`, nullable
- **settings**: `jsonb`, nullable
- **custom_params**: `jsonb`, nullable
- **created_at**: `timestamp with time zone`, not null, default: `now()`
- **updated_at**: `timestamp with time zone`, not null, default: `now()`

要解决此问题，可以按照以下步骤操作：

1. **检查现有记录**：在插入或更新插件之前，检查 `user_installed_plugins` 表中是否已经存在具有相同 `identifier` 的记录。

2. **更新现有记录**：如果存在具有相同 `identifier` 的记录，请更新现有记录而不是插入新记录。

3. **生成唯一标识符**：确保新插件具有唯一的 `identifier` 值，以避免冲突。

以下是检查现有记录并在必要时更新它们的示例：

```sql
-- 检查是否存在具有相同 identifier 的插件
SELECT id FROM user_installed_plugins WHERE identifier = 'your_plugin_identifier';

-- 如果存在记录，则更新它
UPDATE user_installed_plugins
SET name = 'new_name', manifest = 'new_manifest', settings = 'new_settings', updated_at = NOW()
WHERE identifier = 'your_plugin_identifier';

-- 如果不存在记录，则插入新记录
INSERT INTO user_installed_plugins (identifier, name, manifest, settings, created_at, updated_at)
VALUES ('your_plugin_identifier', 'new_name', 'new_manifest', 'new_settings', NOW(), NOW());
```

通过确保 `identifier` 的唯一性并适当地处理更新，可以避免 "duplicate key value violates unique constraint" 错误 <sup>[[1]](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/blob/main/src/database/server/migrations/meta/0005_snapshot.json)</sup><sup>[[2]](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/blob/main/src/database/server/migrations/meta/0008_snapshot.json)</sup>.

@vjeson 你好！我是[Dosu](https://dosu.dev)，我是一个可以帮助你解决bug，回答问题并成为贡献者的机器人。我会在人类维护者到来之前帮助你。期待能够帮到你！🤖

<!-- Answer -->
I found some similar discussions and issues related to your request:

1. [希望能够增加openai的接口数量](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/discussions/3383) (open discussion) <sup>[[1]](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/discussions/3383)</sup>
2. [[Request] 对于各模型、各平台的支持希望可以以plugin的形式出现。](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/discussions/2576) (open discussion) <sup>[[2]](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/discussions/2576)</sup>
3. [[Request] 希望同一个服务商能管理多个不同的key](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/issues/3079) (closed issue) <sup>[[3]](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/issues/3079)</sup>

Regarding your request to add multiple API service providers of the same type, it is indeed possible to customize and add multiple API service providers of the same type in LobeChat. You can achieve this by setting environment variables to control and customize the model list. For example, you can use the `OPENAI_MODEL_LIST` environment variable to add, hide, or customize the display of models:

```fish
$ docker run -d -p 3210:3210 \
  -e OPENAI_API_KEY=sk-xxxx \
  -e OPENAI_MODEL_LIST="qwen-7b-chat,+glm-6b,-gpt-3.5-turbo" \
  --name lobe-chat \
  lobehub/lobe-chat
```

In this example:
- `qwen-7b-chat` is the default displayed model.
- `+glm-6b` is an added model.
- `-gpt-3.5-turbo` is a hidden model.

LobeChat supports multiple AI service providers, including OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Google AI, Anthropic AI, AWS Bedrock, DeepSeek AI, OpenRouter AI, TogetherAI, Ollama, Moonshot AI, Perplexity AI, Minimax AI, Mistral AI, Groq AI, ZhiPu AI, and 01 AI. Each provider has corresponding environment variable configurations that can be used to enable or disable specific providers and customize the model list.

For example, when using Azure OpenAI, you can configure it as follows:

```fish
$ docker run -d -p 3210:3210 \
  -e AZURE_API_KEY=c55168be3874490ef0565d9779ecd5a6 \
  -e AZURE_ENDPOINT=https://docs-test-001.openai.azure.com \
  -e AZURE_API_VERSION=2024-02-01 \
  -e AZURE_MODEL_LIST="gpt-35-turbo->my-deploy=GPT 3.5 Turbo" \
  --name lobe-chat \
  lobehub/lobe-chat
```

This flexibility allows you to manage multiple API service providers of the same type by configuring the environment variables accordingly <sup>[[4]](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/blob/main/README.md)</sup><sup>[[5]](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/blob/main/docs/self-hosting/environment-variables/model-provider.zh-CN.mdx)</sup><sup>[[6]](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/blob/main/src/config/modelProviders/anthropic.ts)</sup><sup>[[7]](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/blob/main/src/app/api/chat/agentRuntime.ts)</sup><sup>[[8]](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/blob/main/src/libs/agent-runtime/AgentRuntime.test.ts)</sup>.

2. [请教各位大佬，文件分块失败](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/discussions/3560) - This discussion suggests checking if Cloudflare (cf) shield or similar protection is enabled, which might be causing the issue <sup>[[2]](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/discussions/3560)</sup>.

The error message you are seeing, "[TriggerError]: trigger file parse async task error. Please check your app is public available or check your proxy settings is set correctly," indicates that there might be an issue with your app's public availability or proxy settings.

Given your deployment setup (NAS with Docker, internal network tunneling to VPS, and reverse proxy with HTTPS), here are a few steps you can take to troubleshoot:

1. **Check Public Availability**: Ensure that your app is accessible publicly without any restrictions. Verify that the URL is correctly configured and reachable from the internet.

2. **Proxy Settings**: Double-check your proxy settings. Ensure that the proxy URL is correctly set and that there are no SSL issues. You might need to configure the proxy settings in the `ProviderConfig` component and the environment configuration file `src/config/llm.ts` <sup>[[3]](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/blob/main/src/app/(main)/settings/llm/components/ProviderConfig/index.tsx)</sup><sup>[[4]](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/blob/main/src/config/llm.ts)</sup>.

3. **SSL Configuration**: The error logs indicate SSL issues (`ERR_SSL_WRONG_VERSION_NUMBER`). Ensure that your SSL certificates are correctly configured and that the SSL/TLS versions are compatible between your app and the proxy.

4. **Supported Models**: The logs also mention that the model `meta-llama/Meta-Llama-3.1-405B-Instruct` is not supported. Verify that you are using supported models listed in `src/libs/agent-runtime/togetherai/fixtures/models.json` <sup>[[5]](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/blob/main/src/libs/agent-runtime/togetherai/fixtures/models.json)</sup>.

By addressing these points, you should be able to resolve the chunking error.

> Author

我这边问题都解决了，我最后也是上了cloudflare然后 zero trust 又买了域名做了DNS解析才搞定
官方文档的两个方式，一个本地版本，一个生产环境
这本地版本，直接本地使用是可以分块的一切正常。如果映射出去，第一个是鉴权那个跳转会有问题，紧接着s3也会有问题，你要是都反向代理出去，其实就成了生产环境的部署，还是不能分块
直接生产环境部署，就是之前说的分块不成功的问题
我最终发现这个生产环境所有的地址都必须是配置域名然后做代理才行，不能加端口，因为我威联通nas只有ipv6公网地址，所以用威联通公网ipv6地址做反向代理必须是加各种端口，但是这样就是会导致分块不成功
我上了cloudflare然后 zero trust 又买了域名做了做了透传才最终搞定，一切分块都正常
这时候我已经用了cloudflare r2 存储和 auth0鉴权，其实这时候本地用minio和logto也是可以成功的，不过就是要给他们的web还有api都要加域，就像文档里说的这样才可以，然后文件就可以进行分块了

----    
> Author

All the problems on my side were solved. I ended up using cloudflare and then using zero trust to buy a domain name and do DNS resolution.
Two ways of official documentation, one local version and one production environment
This local version can be divided into chunks for direct local use and everything will work fine. If mapped out, there will be a problem with the authentication jump first, and then there will be a problem with s3. If you reverse proxy them all, it will actually become a production environment deployment, and it still cannot be divided into chunks.
Deploying directly to the production environment is the problem of unsuccessful chunking mentioned before.
I finally found that all addresses in this production environment must be configured with domain names and then used as proxies. Ports cannot be added because my QNAP NAS only has IPv6 public network addresses, so using QNAP public IPv6 addresses as reverse proxy must be added. Various ports, but this will lead to unsuccessful chunking
I went to cloudflare and then bought a domain name with zero trust and did transparent transmission before finally getting it done. Everything was divided into chunks normally.
At this time, I have used cloudflare r2 storage and auth0 authentication. In fact, using minio and logto locally at this time can also be successful, but it is necessary to add domains to their web and api, as stated in the document. Yes, then the file can be divided into chunks

For your specific issue, ensure that your internal DNS and Nginx configurations are correctly set up. Here are the required configurations:

### Internal DNS Configuration
Set up domain names and corresponding service ports for reverse proxy:
- `lobe.example.com`: Reverse proxy to the LobeChat service port, default is `3210`
- `lobe-auth-api.example.com`: Reverse proxy to the Logto API service port, default is `3001`
- `lobe-auth-ui.example.com`: Reverse proxy to the Logto WebUI service port, default is `3002`
- `lobe-s3-api.example.com`: Reverse proxy to the MinIO API service port, default is `9000`
- `lobe-s3-ui.example.com`: Optional, reverse proxy to the MinIO WebUI service port, default is `9001`

### Nginx Configuration
Example Nginx configuration for the above domains:

```nginx
server {
    listen 80;
    server_name lobe.example.com;

    location / {
        proxy_pass http://localhost:3210;
        proxy_set_header Host $host;
        proxy_set_header X-Real-IP $remote_addr;
        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for;
        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Proto $scheme;
    }
}

server {
    listen 80;
    server_name lobe-auth-api.example.com;

    location / {
        proxy_pass http://localhost:3001;
        proxy_set_header Host $host;
        proxy_set_header X-Real-IP $remote_addr;
        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for;
        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Proto $scheme;
    }
}

server {
    listen 80;
    server_name lobe-auth-ui.example.com;

    location / {
        proxy_pass http://localhost:3002;
        proxy_set_header Host $host;
        proxy_set_header X-Real-IP $remote_addr;
        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for;
        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Proto $scheme;
    }
}

server {
    listen 80;
    server_name lobe-s3-api.example.com;

    location / {
        proxy_pass http://localhost:9000;
        proxy_set_header Host $host;
        proxy_set_header X-Real-IP $remote_addr;
        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for;
        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Proto $scheme;
    }
}

server {
    listen 80;
    server_name lobe-s3-ui.example.com;

    location / {
        proxy_pass http://localhost:9001;
        proxy_set_header Host $host;
        proxy_set_header X-Real-IP $remote_addr;
        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for;
        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Proto $scheme;
    }
}
```

### Important Notes
- Ensure that CORS cross-origin is configured internally in MinIO / Logto service, and do not configure CORS additionally in your reverse proxy.
- Configure SSL certificates uniformly in the outer Nginx reverse proxy, rather than in MinIO <sup>[[1]](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/blob/main/docs/self-hosting/server-database/docker-compose.mdx)</sup>.
