body:
<!-- Answer -->
I found a similar discussion regarding issues with proxy URL configurations when deploying Lobe Chat in server mode using Docker. The discussion titled [使用docker run和docker compose部署lobe，环境变量配置未生效](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/discussions/5879) is still open and might provide insights into your issue <sup>[[1]](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/discussions/5879)</sup>.

To address your problem, ensure that the environment variables are correctly set and that the Ollama proxy URL is prioritized over the OpenAI API proxy address. Here are some steps you can follow:

1. Verify that the `DEFAULT_FILES_CONFIG` and `OLLAMA_PROXY_URL` environment variables are correctly set in your Docker setup:

   ```plaintext
   DEFAULT_FILES_CONFIG="embedding_model=ollama/bge-m3"
   OLLAMA_PROXY_URL=https://ollama.proxy.example.com
   ```

2. Ensure that the OpenAI API proxy address is not set in the AI service provider configuration if you want to use the Ollama proxy URL for embedding requests.

3. If the issue persists, consider checking the configuration file `src/config/llm.ts` to ensure that the environment variables for AI service providers are correctly set and that the Ollama proxy URL is being used <sup>[[2]](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/blob/main/src/config/llm.ts)</sup>.

If clearing the OpenAI API proxy address resolves the issue, it indicates that the system defaults to using the OpenAI proxy when both are configured. Adjusting the configuration to prioritize the Ollama proxy URL should help.

For the issue you're experiencing, ensure that the `APP_URL` environment variable is correctly set and accessible, as it plays a crucial role in the application's functionality, especially for tRPC calls and vectorization processes <sup>[[2]](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/issues/7217)</sup>. Make sure that your S3 storage settings are correctly configured, including the necessary environment variables such as `S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID`, `S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY`, `S3_ENDPOINT`, `S3_BUCKET`, and `S3_PUBLIC_DOMAIN` <sup>[[4]](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/blob/main/docs/self-hosting/advanced/s3.mdx)</sup>. Proper CORS settings for S3 storage are also essential to allow cross-origin requests <sup>[[5]](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/blob/main/docs/self-hosting/server-database/vercel.mdx)</sup>.

<!-- Answer -->
The issue you're experiencing with single Chinese character input disappearing when using Fcitx5 on Arch Linux in the lobe-chat client mode might be related to how the input events are handled. The `lobe-chat` uses `onCompositionStart` and `onCompositionEnd` events to manage input methods like Fcitx5. These events ensure that the input method is recognized and that the Enter key does not prematurely send the message while composing characters <sup>[[1]](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/blob/main/src/features/ChatInput/Desktop/InputArea/index.tsx)</sup>.

However, if single characters are disappearing, it might be due to a bug or a compatibility issue with the input method. You might want to check if there are any updates or patches available for the lobe-chat that address this specific issue. Additionally, reviewing the configuration of Fcitx5 and ensuring it is correctly set up for your system might help resolve the problem.

body:
<!-- Answer -->
To address the issue of long model names not displaying completely on mobile devices, you can consider using CSS properties that handle text overflow or truncation. The lobe-chat codebase uses the following properties:

```css
overflow: hidden;
text-overflow: ellipsis;
white-space: nowrap;
```

These properties can help ensure that text is truncated with an ellipsis when it exceeds the available space, preventing it from being cut off abruptly <sup>[[1]](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/blob/main/src/features/Conversation/Messages/Assistant/Tool/Inspector/ToolTitle.tsx)</sup><sup>[[2]](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/blob/main/src/tools/local-files/components/FileItem.tsx)</sup>.

Additionally, for mobile devices, the `Popover` component is styled to ensure content is fully visible by setting its width to the full viewport width (`100vw`) when the device is mobile <sup>[[3]](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/blob/main/src/features/ChatInput/ActionBar/Model/index.tsx)</sup>. This approach can be useful for ensuring that model names are displayed correctly on smaller screens.

If these solutions don't resolve the issue, you might need to explore further adjustments in the layout or font size specifically for mobile views.

Hello @lee88688! I'm here to help you with bugs, answer questions, and assist you in becoming a contributor. While you're waiting for a human maintainer, feel free to share any details or questions you have, and let's work together to solve your issue!

<!-- Answer -->
To resolve the "JavaScript heap out of memory" error when deploying the Docker image `lobehub/lobe-chat:1.80.3` on a low-memory Debian machine with only 512MB of RAM, you should adjust the `NODE_OPTIONS` environment variable to allocate less memory for Node.js. The current setting in the Dockerfile is `NODE_OPTIONS="--max-old-space-size=8192"`, which allocates 8192 MB of memory, far exceeding the available 512 MB.

You can modify the `NODE_OPTIONS` to allocate a smaller amount of memory, such as 256 MB, by setting it to:

```dockerfile
ENV NODE_OPTIONS="--max-old-space-size=256"
```

This change should be made in the Dockerfile or passed as an environment variable when running the Docker container. This adjustment will help prevent the "JavaScript heap out of memory" error by ensuring Node.js does not attempt to use more memory than is available on your machine <sup>[[1]](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/blob/main/Dockerfile.pglite)</sup>.

<!-- Answer -->
To resolve the issue with the Azure OpenAI o3-mini model in your Docker deployment on Ubuntu, you need to ensure that unsupported parameters are not included in your API request. Specifically, for the o3-mini model, you should exclude the following parameters:

- `top_p`
- `frequency_penalty`
- `presence_penalty`
- `temperature`

It seems you have already configured the `AZURE_MODEL_LIST` environment variable to exclude these parameters for the o3-mini model. Make sure that this configuration is correctly applied in your Docker setup. If the issue persists, double-check that the environment variables are correctly set and that the Docker containers are using the updated configuration. Restarting the Docker containers after making changes to the environment variables might also help apply the new settings <sup>[[1]](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/issues/7493)</sup>.

2. 我不觉得 Cherry Studio 的配置页面是个好的产品方案。**尤其是** JSON 配置的方式，是非常反用户直觉，且不易理解的。在我看来 Cluade Desktop   用 `mcpServer` 字段添加 server 是一个偷懒的产品做法，市面上的产品都照这个抄只能说是被一路带歪，这个头开得非常坏。而且像 env 这种敏感环境变量直接配置还是非常不安全的做法。在长期演进角度来看注定是会被淘汰的

3. 设定的助手应能记住启用哪些mcp和插件，这个我们一开始做插件的时候就支持了

body: @arvinxx 其实我也觉得cherrystudio的配置不太好用，但是有个好处。 很多mcp服务STDIO的配置说明页面都是以JSON的形式给出 以微软的Playwright Mcp服务为例： 通常只需要简单的复制到输入框内就能正常使用了，不用单独的进行填写，反而降低了配置的难度。 而目前lobe-chat在桌面端的实现 让人觉得有些手足无措，不知道怎么配置。 所以改善插件/mcp服务的操作体验上有这么几个关键点： 1.分级的配置 包含系统默认和全局的配置（目前缺乏） 和对话角色绑定的实例化配置（已实现） 1.1多入口进行配置 比如： 点击助手-回话设置可以进行配置 点击输入框上的扩展插件按钮也能进行配置 etc... 2.配置管理便捷 2.1 对默认启用mcp和插件进行统一管理（目前缺乏） 期望同时支持GUI和JSON两种形式的配置，为不同行业背景的客户提供便利。 2.2 功能入口的路径太长，启用/停用插件 需要点击-扩展插件-插件商店-已安装才能启用和停用插件。 用户很难在没有说明文档的情况下找到入口。 功能入口的层级太深导致用户不知道如何启用mcp的相关功能，目前我已经看到好几个人在帖子里问了。 另外主界面上discover的界面上也能找到插件相关的内容，但是无法跳转到插件的配置页面，这里对于用户的操作有一定的迷惑性。 这方面cherry studio的方案在易用性上确实做的好一点。虽然多选启用的操作也有点反人类 cherry目前的设计 既能看到自己对插件的备注说明，多选和启用停用的操作也相对便捷和直观。用户直接就能上手 这是我基于产品交互的角度提出的一些建议，希望能予以考虑。 @arvinxx

To streamable http, theoretically, just find an mcp proxy that supports streamable http, and then configure Nginx to add basic auth to mcp proxy. In this way, any mcp clinet that supports basic auth (as long as it can support connections such as `http://user:pass@example.com`) can safely connect to remotely deployed mcp server, regardless of whether this server has only stdio or not.

Hello @Ukenn2112! I'm here to help you solve bugs, answer questions, and assist you in becoming a contributor. While you're waiting for a human maintainer, feel free to ask me anything you need help with!

<!-- Answer -->
The error message "react-i18next: You will need to pass in an i18next instance by using initReactI18next" indicates that the `useTranslation` hook is unable to find the i18next instance. This typically happens when the i18next instance is not properly initialized or not correctly passed to the React context.

Here are some steps to troubleshoot and resolve this issue:

1. **Ensure Proper Initialization**: Verify that the i18next instance is correctly initialized with the `initReactI18next` plugin. This should be done in your i18n setup file. Make sure the initialization code looks similar to this:

   ```javascript
   import i18n from 'i18next';
   import { initReactI18next } from 'react-i18next';

   i18n
     .use(initReactI18next) // Passes i18n down to react-i18next
     .init({
       // your i18n options here
     });
   ```

2. **Check for Missing Imports**: Ensure that all necessary imports are present in your setup file, including `i18next` and `initReactI18next`.

3. **Verify Docker Configuration**: Since you are using Docker, ensure that the environment variables and configurations are correctly set up in your Docker environment. This includes checking any volume mounts or environment variables that might affect the i18next configuration.

4. **Inspect Application Startup**: The application startup process should correctly initialize i18next before rendering any components that use the `useTranslation` hook. Ensure that the initialization code is executed before any components are rendered.

5. **Check for Recent Changes**: If this issue started occurring after an update, review any recent changes to the i18next setup or related configuration files. There might be changes that affect how the i18next instance is initialized or passed to the React context.

By following these steps, you should be able to resolve the "NO_I18NEXT_INSTANCE" error and ensure that the `useTranslation` hook can access the i18next instance correctly. If the issue persists, consider checking the logs for additional clues or errors that might indicate what is going wrong during the initialization process.

Here are some steps to troubleshoot and resolve this issue:

1. **Ensure Proper Initialization**: Verify that the i18next instance is correctly initialized with the `initReactI18next` plugin. This is crucial for integrating i18next with React. Check the initialization code to ensure it looks something like this:

   ```javascript
   import i18n from 'i18next';
   import { initReactI18next } from 'react-i18next';

   i18n
     .use(initReactI18next) // Passes i18n down to react-i18next

<!-- Greeting -->
Hello @jysz! I'm [Dosu](https://dosu.dev), your friendly bot ready to help you solve bugs, answer questions, and guide you as a contributor while you wait for a human maintainer. Let's tackle this issue together!

<!-- Answer -->
To resolve the issues with Clerk integration in your LobeChat deployment on Clawcloud, you need to ensure the correct setup of environment variables and deployment mode. Here are some steps and considerations:

1. **Deployment Mode**: Clerk authentication cannot be used with LobeChat in client mode. You need to use the server database mode for authentication functionality. Ensure that you are using the database version of the LobeChat image instead of the standard one <sup>[[1]](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/issues/6507)</sup>.

2. **Environment Variables**: Make sure you have correctly set the necessary Clerk-related environment variables:
   - `NEXT_PUBLIC_CLERK_PUBLISHABLE_KEY`
   - `CLERK_SECRET_KEY`
   - `CLERK_WEBHOOK_SECRET`

   These keys are crucial for the Clerk integration to function properly. Double-check that these variables are correctly set in your environment and accessible by the application <sup>[[1]](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/issues/6507)</sup>.

3. **Middleware Configuration**: Ensure that the `NEXT_PUBLIC_ENABLE_CLERK_AUTH` environment variable is set to enable Clerk authentication. This is important because the middleware uses this variable to determine whether to apply Clerk authentication or not <sup>[[1]](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/issues/6507)</sup>.

4. **React Error**: The error "useSession can only be used within the `<ClerkProvider />` component" suggests that the `<ClerkProvider />` is not correctly wrapping your application. Verify that your application is structured correctly with the `<ClerkProvider />` component wrapping the necessary parts of your app <sup>[[1]](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/issues/6507)</sup>.

By following these steps, you should be able to resolve the issues and enable proper multi-user functionality in your LobeChat deployment.

body:
I think an ideal implementation would be supporting OAuth in the MCP client. This Auth0 article explains what the flow would look like: https://auth0.com/blog/an-introduction-to-mcp-and-authorization/

Here's another good article on this topic: https://aaronparecki.com/2025/04/03/15/oauth-for-model-context-protocol
author: lawndoc

body:
The basic auth usage is just suitable for a self-deployed MCP server that only meant to be used by one person or a few ppl only (which most of us is in this case), of course it can't provide robust auth infra like auth0 or any OAuth service providers. 

However, I think the current MCP spec messed up the OAuth that [combine authorization server and resources services into one](https://blog.christianposta.com/the-updated-mcp-oauth-spec-is-a-mess/). Fortunately, MCP spec recently drafted a [new spec](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/modelcontextprotocol/blob/63ccd1a416de4ffe7c24d8257f8f3c849e4ea0f8/docs/specification/draft/basic/authorization.mdx) that fixed the [OAuth problem](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/modelcontextprotocol/issues/205)
author: CXwudi

body: So conclusion, for OAuth integration, wait until the newer spec release

body:
<!-- Answer -->
The issue you're experiencing with the inconsistent display of AI models and capabilities between the configuration and chat interfaces might be related to a few known issues in the lobe-chat application.

1. **Duplicate Entries**: The appearance of duplicate entries, such as seeing two instances of PPIO, could be due to how the application handles model listing. The application uses a case-insensitive comparison to match model names with known models, which might lead to duplicates if there are slight variations in naming or configuration <sup>[[1]](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/blob/main/src/libs/agent-runtime/openai/index.ts)</sup><sup>[[2]](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/blob/main/src/libs/agent-runtime/cohere/index.ts)</sup>.

2. **Model Capabilities Not Displaying**: If model capabilities are shown in the configuration section but not in the chat interface, it might be due to a synchronization issue. This has been a known problem in earlier versions, where model capabilities might not appear correctly due to display name issues or synchronization problems. Ensure you are using the latest version, as updates often include fixes for these types of issues <sup>[[3]](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/issues/5456)</sup><sup>[[4]](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/issues/5327)</sup>.

3. **Configuration Synchronization**: The application uses React hooks to synchronize configuration settings with the chat interface. If there are discrepancies, it might be due to a delay or failure in this synchronization process. Double-check that the configuration changes are saved and reflected in the chat interface <sup>[[5]](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/blob/main/src/features/AgentSetting/AgentChat/index.tsx)</sup>.

To address these issues, consider checking for any updates or patches that might resolve these inconsistencies. Additionally, reviewing the configuration settings to ensure they are correctly applied and saved might help in resolving the display issues.

body:
<!-- Answer -->
To resolve the "向量化失败 [EmbeddingError]: ProviderBizError" error when uploading files in the lobe-chat client mode, you can try the following solutions:

1. **Delete Previously Uploaded Files**: Remove any previously uploaded files that may be consuming system resources, as this can prevent new uploads.

2. **Check Network Connection**: Ensure your network connection is stable and verify that the file storage service's cross-origin configuration is correct. This can help address any network-related issues that might be causing the error.

3. **Switch Deployment Mode**: The current client database deployment mode does not support file management features. Consider switching to a server database deployment mode or using LobeChat Cloud, which supports a wide range of file types and provides high-performance vector models for semantic retrieval of file content.

4. **Provider Service Error**: The error message indicates a problem with the provider service. Check the provider's API key and configuration settings to ensure they are correct. If the issue persists, consult the provider's documentation or support for further troubleshooting <sup>[[1]](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/issues/5653)</sup>.

- A 'Bad Request' error from the OpenAI API (status code 400).
- An undefined API, indicated by the error message 'api is undefined'.
- A 504 Gateway Timeout error from the OpenAI provider, suggesting issues with the API channel configuration or connection.
- An invalid API key, indicated by the error reason 'API_KEY_INVALID' <sup>[[4]](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/blob/main/src/libs/agent-runtime/openai/index.test.ts)</sup><sup>[[5]](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/issues/5496)</sup>.

To resolve these issues, consider checking your API key for validity, ensuring the API channel is correctly configured, or switching to a different API provider.

Hello @36bian! I'm here to help you with any bugs, answer your questions, and assist you while you wait for a human maintainer. Let's tackle this issue together!

<!-- Answer -->
To resolve the issue of the Docker container running the lobe-chat image exiting with an error code null on versions v1.40.0 and later, you should update to the latest version of the Docker image. This error is related to a specific version issue that was fixed in a newer release <sup>[[1]](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/issues/6591)</sup>.

Additionally, the changes introduced in the lobe-chat Docker image version v1.40.0 include setting `NODE_OPTIONS` to `--dns-result-order=ipv4first --use-openssl-ca`, which affects how Node.js resolves DNS queries and handles SSL certificates. This might impact network operations and security settings within the Node.js process. The `NODE_OPTIONS` environment variable is also set to `--max-old-space-size=8192` during the build process, which could affect memory usage and performance <sup>[[2]](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/blob/main/Dockerfile.database)</sup><sup>[[3]](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/blob/main/Dockerfile)</sup><sup>[[4]](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/blob/main/Dockerfile.pglite)</sup>.

If you are experiencing issues with the `punycode` module deprecation warning, note that while this does not directly affect Docker deployments, it is recommended to use a userland alternative for the `punycode` module <sup>[[5]](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/issues/5588)</sup>.

body:
<!-- Answer -->
The issue you're experiencing with the search results in the lobe-chat framework, where results from Docker Hub and Mozilla are overly prioritized, might be due to the current implementation of the search function. The search function in lobe-chat uses the `Search1APIImpl` class, which does not specifically prioritize results based on relevance or other metrics, as the `score` is set to a default value of 1 for all results <sup>[[1]](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/blob/main/src/server/services/search/impls/search1api/index.ts)</sup>.

To address this, you might consider the following approaches:

1. **Adjust Search Engine Configuration**: Ensure that the SearXNG instance is properly configured to prioritize more relevant sources like official documentation or Stack Overflow. This might involve adjusting the search engine preferences or categories used in the SearXNG configuration.

2. **Modify Search Function**: You could modify the search function to include a more sophisticated scoring mechanism that takes into account the relevance of the source, such as giving higher scores to official documentation or community forums like Stack Overflow.

3. **Custom Search Strategy**: Implement a custom search strategy within the 'Smart Online Search' feature to better analyze the query and select more appropriate search engines or categories based on the query type <sup>[[2]](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/blob/main/src/tools/web-browsing/systemRole.ts)</sup>.

These adjustments could help in obtaining more relevant search results that align better with manual searches.

1.部分模型不支持图片识别，来回切换模型很麻烦，降低用户体验。而且似乎有时在上下文中有图片的时候，切换成非视觉模型回答会报错
2.如果全靠视觉模型来回答图片问题，费用会比较高（通常视觉模型的输出每百万token费用会很贵），成本能少一点是一点嘛
3.这个主要不是为了理解图片复杂的内容，主要是为了ocr识别，大模型进行视觉识别效果会好于传统ocr识别（在图片内容辨识度不好的情况下，例如手写字和公式等），此外也会降低开发难度和部署难度，只需调用视觉大模型即可
4.部分低成本视觉模型的性能也不太好，所以可以将视觉模型ocr识别的内容回传给性能表现较好的大模型

这样做也是为了使用体验嘛，来回切换模型体验不是太好，另一方面也是为了降低成本，自己部署玩玩，也是资源条件比较羞涩

Hello @zch401! I'm [Dosu](https://dosu.dev), here to help you tackle bugs, answer questions, and navigate the world of contributions while you wait for a human maintainer. Let's dive into your issue together! 🤖

<!-- Answer -->
I found some similar discussions and issues that might help you resolve the NextAuth configuration error you're encountering:

1. **[Next auth use Logto provider fail](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/discussions/7343#discussioncomment-12773178)**: This discussion suggests checking the connectivity with the Logto provider if a fetch failed error occurs <sup>[[1]](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/discussions/7343)</sup>.

2. **[Bug: next-auth fetch failed with third auth provider](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/discussions/3847#discussioncomment-10586671)**: It is recommended to try using a `PROXY_URL` to resolve fetch failed errors <sup>[[2]](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/discussions/3847)</sup>.

3. **[Authentication with Microsoft-entra-id and nginx/docker configuration does not work](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/discussions/6117)**: This unsolved discussion might provide insights into similar issues with authentication and Nginx/Docker configurations <sup>[[3]](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/discussions/6117)</sup>.

4. **[Bug: 使用docker-compose部署端口模式，nginx反向代理后 无法登录](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/issues/6575)**: A closed issue suggests commenting out the line `proxy_buffering off;` in the Nginx configuration to resolve login issues <sup>[[4]](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/issues/6575)</sup>.

To address your specific issue, ensure that your DNS settings are correctly configured to resolve necessary domains and endpoints. Additionally, consider pinning your Docker image version to 1.51.3, as later versions have known issues with NextAuth integration <sup>[[5]](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/issues/7023)</sup>. Also, verify that your Nginx reverse proxy configuration is correct, especially the headers and proxy settings, as incorrect configurations can lead to authentication errors <sup>[[6]](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/issues/7505)</sup>.

Hello @a328929! I'm here to assist you with any bugs or questions you have while we wait for a human maintainer. Feel free to ask me anything!

<!-- Answer -->
LobeChat 代码库中可以利用 `react-i18next` 库的 `useTranslation` 钩子为按钮添加无障碍标签。这在 `useCustomActions` 函数中有所体现，其中动作的标签是通过 `t` 函数将文本键翻译为适当的语言标签。例如，`translate` 和 `tts` 动作的标签分别定义为 `t('translate.action')` 和 `t('tts.action')`。此外，像 `SettingButton` 这样的组件使用 `Tooltip` 组件为按钮提供可访问的文本描述，例如 `openChatSettings` 按钮使用 `t('openChatSettings.title', { ns: 'hotkey' })` 提供翻译后的标题<sup>[[1]](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/blob/main/src/features/Conversation/Actions/customAction.ts)</sup><sup>[[2]](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/blob/main/src/app/[variants]/(main)/chat/(workspace)/features/SettingButton.tsx)</sup><sup>[[3]](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/blob/main/src/features/ChatInput/ActionBar/Knowledge/index.tsx)</sup>。

要解决无障碍标签缺失的问题，可以在相关按钮组件中使用 `useTranslation` 钩子为每个按钮添加适当的标签和描述，以确保屏幕阅读器能够正确识别和读出这些按钮的功能。

body:
<!-- Answer -->
The issue you're experiencing with the MCP plugin resulting in a white screen after installation could be related to several factors. Here are some steps and considerations to help troubleshoot and resolve the problem:

1. **Check Plugin Configuration**: Ensure that the Streamable HTTP Endpoint URL is correctly configured and accessible. The URL should not end with `/sse` and must point to a valid MCP server <sup>[[1]](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/blob/main/locales/it-IT/plugin.json)</sup>.

2. **Test Connection**: Use the connection test feature to verify that the MCP plugin can connect to the server successfully. A failed connection test might indicate network issues or incorrect endpoint configuration <sup>[[2]](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/blob/main/locales/fa-IR/plugin.json)</sup>.

3. **Enable Debugging**: Turn on debugging to get detailed logs about the plugin's operation. This can help identify where the process is failing, such as during the connection or data retrieval phases <sup>[[2]](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/blob/main/locales/fa-IR/plugin.json)</sup>.

4. **Check Docker Configuration**: Ensure that your Docker setup is correctly configured, especially regarding network settings and environment variables. Misconfigurations here can lead to connectivity issues <sup>[[3]](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/blob/main/docker-compose/production/logto/.env.example)</sup>.

5. **Browser Compatibility**: Make sure your Chrome browser is up to date. Although there are no specific known issues with Chrome, keeping the browser updated can prevent unexpected behavior <sup>[[4]](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/blob/main/docs/usage/features/pwa.mdx)</sup>.

6. **Review Logs for Errors**: Look for any error messages in the logs that might indicate what is going wrong. This could include network errors, invalid configurations, or other issues <sup>[[2]](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/blob/main/locales/fa-IR/plugin.json)</sup>.

By following these steps, you should be able to identify and resolve the issue with the MCP plugin installation and operation. If the problem persists, consider checking for any updates or patches that might address known issues.

Hello @codersaadi! I'm here to help you with bugs, answer questions, and assist you in becoming a contributor. While you wait for a human maintainer, feel free to share any concerns or questions you have!

<!-- Answer -->
To retrieve organization-related information from Zitadel using Next Auth, you need to ensure that the scopes you are requesting are supported by Zitadel and that they are correctly configured in your Next Auth setup. The default implementation in the lobe-chat codebase uses the scopes `'openid email profile'` <sup>[[1]](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/blob/main/src/libs/next-auth/sso-providers/zitadel.ts)</sup>. If you need additional claims such as organization ID, name, or domain, you should verify that these scopes are supported by Zitadel and correctly added to your authorization parameters.

If you have already added the scope `urn:zitadel:iam:org:project:id:roles` and are not receiving the expected claims, consider the following steps:

1. **Verify Scope Support**: Ensure that the scope `urn:zitadel:iam:org:project:id:roles` and any other organization-related scopes are supported by Zitadel. You may need to consult Zitadel's documentation or support for this information.

2. **Check Provider Configuration**: Make sure that the scope is correctly added to the `authorization` parameter in your Zitadel provider configuration in Next Auth. It should look something like this:

   ```typescript
   authorization: { params: { scope: 'openid email profile urn:zitadel:iam:org:project:id:roles' } },
   ```

3. **Inspect Returned Claims**: After authentication, inspect the returned claims to see if the organization-related information is included. You might need to adjust the mapping logic in your Next Auth configuration to include these claims in the profile object.

4. **Custom Profile Mapping**: If the claims are returned but not mapped to the profile, you can customize the profile mapping function to include these claims. For example:

   ```typescript
   profile(profile) {
     return {
       email: profile.email,
       image: profile.picture,
       name: profile.name,
       providerAccountId: profile.user_id,
       id: profile.user_id,
       orgId: profile['urn:zitadel:iam:org:id'],
       orgName: profile['urn:zitadel:iam:org:name'],
       orgDomain: profile['urn:zitadel:iam:org:domain'],
     };
   }
   ```

If these steps do not resolve the issue, further investigation into Zitadel's documentation or support might be necessary to ensure the correct scopes and claims are being used.

<!-- Answer -->
The issue you're experiencing with the Lobe Chat desktop application not fully terminating upon closure is related to how the application manages its processes. The application listens for the 'window-all-closed' event and calls `app.quit()` to terminate the application, but it seems that some background services might still be running <sup>[[1]](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/blob/main/apps/desktop/src/main/core/App.ts)</sup>.

To address this, you can try the following steps:

1. **Ensure Complete Shutdown**: After closing the application, manually check the Task Manager to see if any processes related to "LobeHub-Nightly" are still running. If they are, you can manually end these tasks to ensure a complete shutdown.

2. **Reopen the Application**: If the application does not reopen after closing, make sure all related processes are terminated in the Task Manager before attempting to reopen it.

This behavior might be due to a known issue where the application sets a flag `isQuiting` during the `before-quit` event to handle cleanup operations, but it might not be terminating all background services <sup>[[1]](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/blob/main/apps/desktop/src/main/core/App.ts)</sup>. If this issue persists, you might want to check for updates or patches that address this problem in future releases.

body:
> [@arvinxx](https://github.com/arvinxx) I am using Docker Compose to self-host my LobeChat, and it has been working perfectly with desktop version. However, I encountered an issue with image loading. I read your suggested solution:
> 
> > ```
> > If you are using Minio for storage, ensure that cross-origin requests are allowed in the Minio configuration.
> > Add appropriate CORS settings in your Minio service.
> > ```
> 
> However, I am not sure how to configure this. Could you please provide a more detailed explanation? Do I have to do something on docker-compose.yml?

You need to allow cross-origin requests from https://lobe.example.com/. This can be configured either in MinIO WebUI's Configuration - API - Cors Allow Origin, or in Docker Compose's minio - environment - MINIO_API_CORS_ALLOW_ORIGIN.

dokploy在NAS（内网穿透到外网）自行部署main分支版本+macOS客户端，目前遇到的问题：
1.知识库无法点进去，具体表现是如果有一个知识库，想浏览里面的文件或者上传文件到这个知识库，点这个知识库，页面一闪而过，还是到知识库的首页，没办法对这个知识库管理，网页版没问题。
2.macOS客户端好像请求api的时候是本地请求的，比如如果Gemini设置了base url（部署在内网的Gemini balance），这个baseurl是192.168的内网地址，我在外面就无法访问，在家里就可以（openai设置了baseurl也是一样）。这样就需要把我自建的api服务器暴露到外网，macOS客户端才可以正常使用，安全性就降低了。

Dokploy deploys the main branch version + macOS client on NAS (intranet penetration to external network). The current problems are encountered:
1. The knowledge base cannot be clicked in. The specific manifestation is that if there is a knowledge base, you want to browse the files in it or upload files to this knowledge base, click this knowledge base, and the page flashes by, or go to the homepage of the knowledge base, and there is no problem with the web version.
2. The macOS client seems to request the API locally. For example, if Gemini sets the base url (Gemini balance deployed on the intranet), this baseurl is the intranet address of 192.168, which I cannot access outside, so I can do it at home (the same is true for Openai to set the baseurl). In this way, I need to expose my own API server to the external network so that the macOS client can be used normally, and the security will be reduced.

body:
I'm experiencing an issue with the LobeChat desktop client when self-hosting with MinIO as the S3 storage backend. Avatars do not load, and new files cannot be uploaded. The web version of LobeChat appears to be working correctly, and files uploaded via the web version do load correctly in the desktop client.

**Environment:**
*   **LobeChat Version:** Next.js 15.3.5 (from `lobehub/lobe-chat-database` Docker image)
*   **MinIO Version:** RELEASE.2025-04-22T22-12-26Z (from `minio/minio` Docker image)
*   **Deployment:** Docker Compose on Google Cloud (Ubuntu 24.04)
*   **Reverse Proxy:** Nginx
*   **Domains:**
    *   LobeChat: `https://lobe.example.com`
    *   Casdoor (Auth): `https://auth.example.com`
    *   MinIO API: `https://minio.example.com`
    *   MinIO UI: `https://minio-ui.example.com`

**Issue:**
*   **LobeChat Desktop Client:** Avatars do not load, and new files cannot be uploaded. Files uploaded via the web version do load correctly in the desktop client.

**Troubleshooting Steps Taken (and outcomes):**

1.  **MinIO CORS Configuration (`MINIO_API_CORS_ALLOW_ORIGIN` in `docker-compose.yml`):**
    *   Initially set to `*`.
    *   Changed to `https://lobe.example.com`.
    *   Currently set to `https://lobe.example.com,https://auth.example.com`.
    *   **Outcome:** Did not resolve the desktop client issue.

2.  **Nginx WebSocket Configuration:**
    *   Added `proxy_http_version 1.1;`, `proxy_set_header Upgrade $http_upgrade;`, `proxy_set_header Connection "upgrade";` to `minio-ui.example.com` Nginx config.
        *   **Outcome:** Resolved the "infinite loading" issue in MinIO Object Browser.
    *   Added the same WebSocket directives to `minio.example.com` Nginx config.
        *   **Outcome:** Did not resolve the desktop client issue.
    *   Confirmed `lobe.example.com` Nginx config already had these directives.

3.  **MinIO HTTP Trace Logging (`MINIO_HTTP_TRACE`):**
    *   Added `MINIO_HTTP_TRACE=/tmp/minio_trace.log` to the `minio` service environment in `docker-compose.yml`.
    *   **Outcome:** The trace file `/tmp/minio_trace.log` was not created/found inside the MinIO container, and standard MinIO logs showed no errors related to tracing. This prevented detailed HTTP request/response analysis.

4.  **S3 Credentials in `.env`:**
    *   Confirmed that `S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID` and `S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY` are present in `~/lobe-chat-db/.env`.
    *   **Outcome:** The web version works correctly with these credentials, suggesting they are not the primary cause of the desktop client issue.

Despite these steps, the LobeChat desktop client still cannot load avatars or new files. It seems the issue might be specific to how the desktop client interacts with the S3 backend, even with seemingly correct CORS and S3 endpoint configurations.

Any guidance or further debugging steps would be greatly appreciated.
author: ohmyboroda

Hello @akozar! I'm [Dosu](https://dosu.dev), here to help you with bugs, answer questions, and assist with contributions while you wait for a human maintainer. Let's tackle that login issue together!

<!-- Answer -->
To resolve the "Invalid client_id" error when trying to log in to LobeChat via the WebUI while self-hosting with Docker on Ubuntu, you should:

1. **Check Casdoor Configuration**: Ensure that the client ID in your `.env` file matches the one configured in Casdoor. You need to log into the Casdoor admin interface and manually add the redirect URL in the Casdoor configuration. This is necessary because the client ID in the `.env` file might not match what is configured in Casdoor, and the redirect URL may be empty or incorrectly configured <sup>[[1]](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/issues/7322)</sup>.

2. **Verify Deployment Mode**: Make sure you are not deploying the Lobe-chat mirror in Docker client mode, as this version is not supposed to have login functionality. If you are seeing a login button and error page, it might be due to incorrect configuration or deployment, as the mirror version should not include this feature <sup>[[1]](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/issues/7322)</sup>.

These steps should help you resolve the login issue.

body:
<!-- Answer -->
I found a similar thread discussing login issues with LobeChat using the Casdoor endpoint. The issue was related to incorrect reverse proxy configuration and network access problems <sup>[[1]](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/blob/main/docs/self-hosting/server-database/docker-compose.zh-CN.mdx)</sup>. Here are some steps you can take to resolve the issue:

1. **Reverse Proxy Configuration**: Ensure your reverse proxy is correctly configured and not intercepting Casdoor's OAuth2 configuration requests. Verify the response from `http://dev.client.com:8000/.well-known/openid-configuration` is in JSON format. If not, adjust your reverse proxy settings.

2. **Network Access**: Check if LobeChat can access the authentication service. Use `curl` within the LobeChat container to test access to `http://dev.client.com:8000/.well-known/openid-configuration`. Ensure containers can access Casdoor's public network addresses.

3. **Environment Variables**: Confirm all necessary environment variables are correctly set, including `NEXTAUTH_URL`, `NEXT_AUTH_SECRET`, `AUTH_CASDOOR_SECRET`, `AUTH_CASDOOR_ID`, `AUTH_CASDOOR_ISSUER`, and `CASDOOR_WEBHOOK_SECRET`.

4. **Invalid client_id Error**: If you encounter an 'Invalid client_id' error, download the correct `init_data.json` file from [this link](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/main/docker-compose/local/init_data.json) and replace your existing file.

5. **Network Connectivity**: Ensure the LobeChat server and Casdoor container can communicate on the network level. They must be able to ping each other.

Check the logs for specific errors like "response is not a conform Authorization Server Metadata response" or "fetch failed" to diagnose further <sup>[[2]](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/issues/7601)</sup><sup>[[3]](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/issues/6137)</sup>.

<!-- Greeting -->
Hello @downdawn! I'm [Dosu](https://dosu.dev), your friendly bot here to help you solve bugs, answer questions, and assist you in becoming a contributor. I'm here to support you while we wait for a human maintainer. How can I assist you today?

<!-- Answer -->
To resolve the issue of `HTTP_PROXY` and `HTTPS_PROXY` not working in a Docker deployment environment on Ubuntu, preventing access to OpenAI's API using the lobe-chat and lobe-chat-database images, you should ensure that you are using the latest version of Lobe Chat, as the `PROXY_URL` connection errors have been fixed in recent updates. Additionally, configure the proxy settings in your Docker environment by setting the following environment variables in your `.env` file:

```plaintext
PROXY_URL=http://172.17.0.1:7890
HTTP_PROXY=http://172.17.0.1:7890
HTTPS_PROXY=http://172.17.0.1:7890
```

Make sure to replace `172.17.0.1` with your Docker network's gateway IP address and `7890` with your proxy server's port number. This configuration should allow the Docker containers to route their requests through the specified proxy server, enabling access to OpenAI's API. If you continue to experience issues, ensure that your Docker setup is correctly updated and configured.

Additionally, avoid using `127.0.0.1` for the `PROXY_URL` within Docker containers, as this refers to the container's localhost and not the host machine. Instead, use the host machine's network address, such as `172.17.0.1`, to ensure the proxy is accessible from within the Docker container <sup>[[1]](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/issues/7233)</sup><sup>[[2]](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/issues/5334)</sup><sup>[[3]](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/issues/6496)</sup>.

To resolve the connection error with LM Studio in LobeHub-Beta, ensure that the API proxy address is correctly configured. The error message suggests that the API endpoint should end with `/v1`, which appears to be correctly set in your configuration as "http://127.0.0.1:1234/v1". However, if the connection is still failing, consider the following troubleshooting steps:

1. **Verify LM Studio Service**: Ensure that LM Studio is running and the local API service is active. Double-check that CORS is enabled in the service settings to allow external connections.

2. **Check Port Availability**: Confirm that port `1234` is not being used by another application, which could prevent LobeHub-Beta from connecting to LM Studio.

3. **Firewall and Network Settings**: Check your macOS firewall and network settings to ensure that connections to `127.0.0.1:1234` are not being blocked.

4. **Restart Services**: Sometimes restarting both LM Studio and LobeHub-Beta can resolve connectivity issues.

If these steps do not resolve the issue, there might be a deeper compatibility problem between LobeHub-Beta and LM Studio on macOS, which is not documented in the available resources <sup>[[1]](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/blob/main/docs/self-hosting/advanced/desktop.mdx)</sup><sup>[[2]](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/blob/main/docs/usage/providers/lmstudio.zh-CN.mdx)</sup>.

body:
<!-- Answer -->
I found some similar threads related to Vercel build failures in the lobe-chat project:

1. [Vercel 自动部署经常超时，偶尔才能成功一次，除非手动重新部署](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/discussions/4833) - This discussion is open and unsolved <sup>[[1]](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/discussions/4833)</sup>.
2. [部署在vercel的lobechat，最近频繁部署失败](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/discussions/3041) - This discussion is open and unsolved <sup>[[2]](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/discussions/3041)</sup>.
3. [Vercel部署报错出现这种状况改如何解决](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/discussions/1443) - This discussion is open and unsolved <sup>[[3]](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/discussions/1443)</sup>.

Regarding the specific error you encountered, the build failure is due to a type error in the `SelectWithTTSPreview.tsx` component. The `fontSize` property does not exist in the `ActionIconSizeConfig` type. You can resolve this by ensuring that the `ActionIconSizeConfig` type includes the `fontSize` property or by removing the `fontSize` from the `buttonSize` object if it's not needed <sup>[[4]](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/blob/main/src/features/AgentSetting/AgentTTS/SelectWithTTSPreview.tsx)</sup>.

Additionally, common causes of build failures in the lobe-chat project when deploying to Vercel include SIGKILL and Out of Memory errors. You might want to add the environment variable `VERCEL_FORCE_NO_BUILD_CACHE=1` to your Vercel project settings to help mitigate these issues <sup>[[5]](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/issues/6489)</sup>.

body:
<!-- Answer -->
The issue you're experiencing seems to be related to the handling of DOCX files in the lobe-chat system. There is a known problem with processing Word documents (DOC and DOCX formats) where the chunking process can fail, especially if the files are large or have been converted from DOC to DOCX format <sup>[[1]](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/issues/5993)</sup>. 

Here are some steps you can try to resolve the issue:

1. **File Conversion**: Ensure that all Word documents are properly converted to DOCX format using reliable software before uploading. Sometimes conversion issues can lead to processing errors.

2. **File Size**: Check the size of the Word documents. Large files might fail to process due to size limitations. Consider splitting large documents into smaller parts before uploading.

3. **Metadata Management**: When deleting files, ensure that the metadata is also removed. The system should handle metadata persistence, but if files are disappearing, it might be worth checking if the metadata is correctly managed <sup>[[2]](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/blob/main/src/database/models/file.ts)</sup>.

4. **Re-uploading**: After deleting files and databases, try re-uploading the documents and processing them individually to see if the issue persists.

If these steps do not resolve the problem, it might be necessary to investigate further into the system's handling of DOCX files and metadata management.

body:
<!-- Answer -->
I found a similar open issue related to authorization redirection problems in Lobe Chat. The suggested solutions include:

1. **Environment Variables**: Ensure that all necessary environment variables are correctly set. This includes variables like `NEXTAUTH_URL`, which should match the base URL of your application. Double-check that these are correctly configured in your `.env` file.

2. **Callback URL Configuration**: Verify that the callback URL in your OAuth provider settings matches the one used in your application. Any mismatch can lead to redirection issues.

3. **Network Configuration**: Since your server is on a local network, ensure that network settings allow communication between your desktop application and the server. This might involve configuring firewall rules or network permissions.

4. **Debugging**: Enable detailed logging to gain more insights into the authorization process. This can help identify where the process might be failing.

5. **Similar Issues**: There is a similar issue discussed [here](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/discussions/1336) where setting the `NEXTAUTH_URL` environment variable resolved the problem.

These steps might help resolve the issue you're facing with authorization redirection <sup>[[1]](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/issues/5439)</sup>.

Hello @EastlingWoo! I'm here to help you with any bugs, questions, or if you want to become a contributor. Feel free to share more details about your issue, and I'll assist you while we wait for a human maintainer.

<!-- Answer -->
The issue you're experiencing, where data stops displaying after some time and requires reconnection to the Cloud, is likely related to token refresh issues. The repeated "401 Unauthorized" errors in the console suggest that the access token may not be refreshing correctly. This behavior aligns with known issues where the `RemoteServerConfigCtr` class handles token refresh operations, and if the refresh fails, it clears tokens and disables the remote server, requiring re-authorization <sup>[[1]](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/blob/main/apps/desktop/src/main/controllers/RemoteServerConfigCtr.ts)</sup>.

Additionally, a bug fix was implemented in LobeChat version 1.1.16 to address "UNAUTHORIZED" errors after a long-time hang-up, which might be related to your issue. Ensuring that you are using the latest version of LobeChat might help resolve the problem <sup>[[2]](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)</sup>.

Recently updated version found that the copy of the networking function was specially modified to "intelligently choose whether to connect to the Internet", which made me wonder: does this function refer to the prompt word engineering that allows the model to automatically start the search when the user does not explicitly propose a search, or can intelligently select the opening and closing of this plug-in in some way to save user consumption. <!-- Greeting -->
Hello @skymkmk! I'm [Dosu](https://dosu.dev), a bot here to assist you with any bugs or questions you might have. I'm ready to help while you wait for a human maintainer. How can I assist you today?

<!-- Answer -->
The concern raised is about whether the token consumption from the web browsing plugin, particularly when using the "smart selection" feature, is being accounted for in the overall budget. The "smart selection" feature is designed to intelligently determine whether a network search is needed based on the conversation content <sup>[[1]](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/blob/main/locales/zh-CN/chat.json)</sup><sup>[[2]](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/blob/main/locales/pl-PL/chat.json)</sup>. 

Regarding token consumption, the Lobe Chat application calculates token usage for plugins, including the web browsing plugin, by using a function that computes the credit cost based on token usage and pricing <sup>[[3]](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/blob/main/src/features/Conversation/Extras/Usage/UsageDetail/tokens.ts)</sup>. However, if the system prompts related to web browsing are not being counted towards token consumption, this might not align with the expected behavior, as these prompts can influence the search functionality and should ideally be part of the plugin budget.

If the current implementation does not account for these tokens, it might be worth considering an update to include them in the token budget to ensure accurate tracking and management of user consumption.

To address the issue of the AI model list exceeding boundaries on the mobile interface of the LobeChat application, you can ensure that the `Flexbox` components have a `minWidth` set to `0`. This setting allows the `Flexbox` to shrink properly within its container, preventing overflow issues. Here's an example of how this is implemented:

```tsx
<Flexbox align={'center'} flex={1} gap={16} horizontal style={{ minWidth: 0 }}>
  ...
  <Flexbox flex={1} gap={4} style={{ minWidth: 0 }}>
    ...
  </Flexbox>
</Flexbox>
```

If the issue persists, you may need to check other parts of the CSS or parent components to ensure they also allow for proper resizing and do not have fixed widths that could cause overflow <sup>[[1]](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/blob/main/src/app/[variants]/(main)/settings/provider/features/ModelList/ModelItem.tsx)</sup>.

4. 关于按钮悬停自动打开的问题，当前设计可能使得提示框显得不必要。可以考虑调整交互方式，使得提示框在移动端不显示，特别是在点击“编辑对话”和“分支对话”按钮时避免卡顿。

body:
<!-- Answer -->
这个问题可能与 Vercel 的超时限制有关。Vercel 在服务端模式下有一个内置的超时限制，最长等待时间为 125 秒。如果响应时间超过这个限制，可能会导致 504 网关超时错误 <sup>[[1]](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/issues/6226)</sup><sup>[[2]](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/issues/6267)</sup>。

为了解决这个问题，可以考虑以下方法：

1. **切换到客户端模式**：客户端模式可以避免由于平台限制而导致的超时错误，因为数据存储在用户设备上，不受 Vercel 的超时限制影响 <sup>[[3]](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/blob/main/docs/self-hosting/start.mdx)</sup><sup>[[4]](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/blob/main/docs/self-hosting/server-database.mdx)</sup>。

2. **使用 Docker 部署**：Docker 没有 Vercel 的这些限制，可以处理较长的推理过程 <sup>[[1]](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/issues/6226)</sup><sup>[[5]](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/issues/5682)</sup>。

这些方法可以帮助处理长时间运行的模型响应，确保深度思考过程能够正常结束。

body:
<!-- Answer -->
在 lobe-chat 框架中，深度思考过程的结束是通过检查 `finish_reason` 字段来确定的。如果 `finish_reason` 存在，则表明思考过程应该结束，并返回一个类型为 `'stop'` 的数据块 <sup>[[1]](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/blob/main/src/libs/agent-runtime/utils/streams/qwen.ts)</sup><sup>[[2]](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/blob/main/src/libs/agent-runtime/utils/streams/openai.ts)</sup>。

如果在使用 Qwen3 系列模型时，深度思考过程没有正确结束，可能需要检查以下几点：

1. **API 响应**：确保 API 响应中包含 `finish_reason` 字段。如果没有，可能需要调整模型或 API 的配置以确保正确输出结束标志。

2. **内容检查**：框架还会检查 `content` 和 `reasoning_content` 是否为空字符串。如果两者都是空字符串，内容会被设置为 `null`，这也标志着思考过程的结束 <sup>[[2]](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/blob/main/src/libs/agent-runtime/utils/streams/openai.ts)</sup>。

3. **模型配置**：确认模型配置中是否启用了深度思考功能，并且在聊天配置中正确设置了相关参数 <sup>[[3]](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/blob/main/src/services/chat.ts)</sup>。

如果这些检查都没有解决问题，可能需要进一步调试或查看框架的具体实现，以确保所有条件都正确满足。

The error "Unexpected end of JSON input" from the "openai" provider, categorized as "ProviderBizError," suggests an issue with the JSON data being processed. This could be due to a change in how the lobe-chat platform handles JSON input for the 'openai' provider. The `transformOpenAIStream` function is responsible for processing JSON input and might be encountering an unexpected format or missing data, leading to this error <sup>[[1]](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/blob/main/src/libs/agent-runtime/utils/streams/openai.ts)</sup>.

To address this issue, you might want to check the following:

1. **Configuration Settings**: Ensure that the configuration for the 'openai' provider is correct, including the API key, endpoint, and model settings. Any misconfiguration could lead to JSON input errors <sup>[[2]](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/blob/main/src/migrations/FromV6ToV7/fixtures/provider-input-v6.json)</sup>.

2. **Recent Updates**: Since the issue started after a recent update, review any changes in the latest version that might affect JSON handling for the 'openai' provider. Although specific changes weren't identified, it's possible that recent updates introduced changes in JSON processing <sup>[[1]](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/blob/main/src/libs/agent-runtime/utils/streams/openai.ts)</sup>.

3. **ProviderBizError Handling**: This error type indicates issues with service requests to the provider, such as authentication errors or incorrect data formats. Ensure that the API key and other credentials are valid and correctly configured <sup>[[3]](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/blob/main/locales/zh-CN/error.json)</sup>.

If the problem persists, consider reverting to a previous version where the issue did not occur or checking for any patches or updates that address this specific problem.

To resolve the error encountered when configuring a custom OpenAI model in Electron on macOS using the lobe-chat client mode, ensure that your proxy configuration supports client fetch capabilities. The empty error object `{"error": {}}` indicates that the proxy does not support client fetch, which is necessary for proper communication with the OpenAI API.

Additionally, if you are using the OpenAI o1 model, make sure to adjust the following parameters:

1. Set the system role message to 'developer'.
2. Add the reasoning_effort parameter (options are 'high', 'medium', or 'low').
3. Ensure the stream parameter is set to false or is not set at all, as streaming is not supported with this model due to beta limitations.

If you are using a custom proxy endpoint, consider switching to OpenAI's official API endpoint, as the o1 model supports streaming through OpenAI's official API but may not be supported through custom proxy endpoints. These adjustments are crucial to avoid compatibility issues and ensure proper functionality with the OpenAI o1 model in LobeChat <sup>[[1]](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/issues/6979)</sup><sup>[[2]](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/issues/5327)</sup><sup>[[3]](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/issues/5018)</sup>.

Hello @xxddff! I'm here to help you with bugs, answer your questions, and assist you in becoming a contributor. I'm a bot, so while you're waiting for a human maintainer, feel free to ask anything you need. Let's tackle this issue together!

<!-- Answer -->
The error "MCP error -32000: Connection closed" when using stdio mode in the lobe-chat framework could be due to several reasons. Here are some potential troubleshooting steps and considerations:

1. **Environment Compatibility**: Ensure that the stdio mode is supported in your environment. The lobe-chat framework does not support stdio mode in non-desktop (web) environments, so make sure you are running it in a compatible environment <sup>[[1]](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/blob/main/src/libs/mcp/__tests__/index.test.ts)</sup><sup>[[2]](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/blob/main/src/libs/mcp/client.ts)</sup>.

2. **Process Management**: Check if the stdio process is being terminated prematurely. Ensure that the process is running correctly and not being closed unexpectedly. You can verify this by checking the logs for any abrupt termination messages.

3. **Command and Arguments**: Double-check the command and arguments used to start the stdio process. Ensure that they are correct and that the `npx` command is properly executing the `firecrawl-mcp` server. You mentioned that running the command directly works, so ensure the same configuration is used within the lobe-chat setup.

4. **Network and Permissions**: Verify that there are no network or permission issues that might be causing the connection to close. Ensure that the necessary permissions are granted for the process to run and communicate over stdio.

5. **Logs and Debugging**: Utilize the logs provided by the lobe-chat framework to gain more insights into what might be causing the connection to close. The logs can provide detailed information about the initialization and any errors encountered <sup>[[2]](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/blob/main/src/libs/mcp/client.ts)</sup><sup>[[3]](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/blob/main/src/server/services/mcp/index.ts)</sup>.

If these steps do not resolve the issue, consider testing with other MCP configurations to see if the problem is specific to the `firecrawl-mcp` setup.

body:
<!-- Answer -->
The issue you're experiencing with the Lobe Chat desktop client not being able to request the LM Studio model, while the PWA and web versions work, could be related to network or CORS settings. Here are some steps to troubleshoot and resolve the issue:

1. **CORS Settings**: Ensure that CORS (Cross-Origin Resource Sharing) is enabled in LM Studio. This is necessary for the desktop client to communicate with LM Studio. You can enable CORS in the LM Studio service settings <sup>[[1]](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/issues/5627)</sup>.

2. **Network Configuration**: Verify that the local API service is running on the correct port (usually `1234`) and that the endpoint is accessible from the desktop client. Make sure the API service address is correctly configured in the Lobe Chat application settings under AI service providers <sup>[[2]](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/blob/main/docs/usage/providers/lmstudio.zh-CN.mdx)</sup>.

3. **HTTPS Protocol**: Ensure that all endpoints are using the HTTPS protocol, as this is required for secure communication <sup>[[1]](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/issues/5627)</sup>.

4. **Client Request Mode**: If LM Studio is running locally, ensure that the `Client Request Mode` is turned on. This setting is crucial for local deployments <sup>[[1]](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/issues/5627)</sup>.

Regarding the "depth of thought" feature, it seems that this functionality is only available when accessing the official Qwen3 model. This might be due to specific configurations or capabilities that are only enabled for the official model version.

If these steps do not resolve the issue, consider checking the network logs for any additional error messages that might provide more insight into the problem.

I found a similar unsolved discussion regarding vectorization errors after text upload in the lobe-chat framework. You can view it [here](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/discussions/6803) <sup>[[1]](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/discussions/6803)</sup>.

For the network error or non-101 status code issue you're encountering, here are some common causes and troubleshooting steps:

1. **Invalid Request Parameters**: Ensure that all request parameters are correct, as incorrect parameters can lead to a status code 400 error.

2. **Authentication Issues**: Verify that your API keys and authentication credentials are correctly configured. Errors like "InvalidProviderAPIKey" can cause such issues.

3. **Network and Connection Issues**: Check your network connectivity and ensure that the API proxy settings are correct. Errors such as "networkError" indicate connectivity problems <sup>[[2]](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/blob/main/locales/ja-JP/error.json)</sup>.

4. **Server Errors**: Temporary server issues can also cause these errors. Ensure that the server is running correctly and try again later <sup>[[2]](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/blob/main/locales/ja-JP/error.json)</sup>.

5. **Embedding Model Configuration**: Make sure that the embedding model configuration is correct. For Ollama, ensure that the service is running locally on the correct port and that the proxy URL is set correctly in your environment variables <sup>[[3]](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/blob/main/docs/self-hosting/examples/ollama.zh-CN.mdx)</sup>.

By addressing these areas, you may be able to resolve the network error you're experiencing. If the issue persists, consider checking the logs for more detailed error messages that could provide further insights.

<!-- Greeting -->
Hey @Roger-Lee! I'm [Dosu](https://dosu.dev), your friendly bot here to help you tackle bugs, answer questions, and guide you in becoming a contributor. I'm here while you wait for a human maintainer. How can I assist you today?

<!-- Answer -->
The issue you're experiencing with LM Studio's API only supporting localhost and not working with a public domain and port mapping might be related to specific network and security settings. Here are some key points to consider:

1. **CORS Settings**: Ensure that the `CORS` option is enabled in the LM Studio service settings. This allows the API to be accessed from other programs, which is crucial for external access <sup>[[1]](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/blob/main/docs/usage/providers/lmstudio.mdx)</sup>.

2. **Proxy and DNS Configuration**: If you're using Docker Desktop on Windows or macOS, remember that `localhost` refers to the container's localhost. You should use `host.docker.internal` instead. Additionally, check the `ENABLE_PROXY_DNS` environment variable; setting it to `1` routes DNS queries through a proxy server, which might resolve access issues <sup>[[2]](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/blob/main/docs/self-hosting/environment-variables/basic.mdx)</sup><sup>[[3]](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/blob/main/docs/self-hosting/environment-variables/basic.zh-CN.mdx)</sup>.

3. **SSRF Protection**: Review the `SSRF_ALLOW_PRIVATE_IP_ADDRESS` environment variable. By default, it is set to `0`, which restricts connections to private IP addresses. Setting it to `1` allows connections to private IPs, which might be necessary in your setup. You can also specify allowed IP addresses using `SSRF_ALLOW_IP_ADDRESS_LIST` <sup>[[2]](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/blob/main/docs/self-hosting/environment-variables/basic.mdx)</sup><sup>[[3]](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/blob/main/docs/self-hosting/environment-variables/basic.zh-CN.mdx)</sup>.

These settings are crucial for enabling external access to the LM Studio API. If these configurations are correctly set and the issue persists, it might be worth checking for any misconfigurations or potential bugs in the setup.

body:
<!-- Answer -->
To resolve the issue of request failure when uploading non-base64 format URL images while using the visual recognition model (qwen3), you can configure LobeChat to use base64 encoding for image uploads. Since you've already set the environment variable `LLM_VISION_IMAGE_USE_BASE64=1`, ensure that the conversion process is correctly implemented in your setup. This setting should convert images to base64 format before uploading, which should resolve the upload errors. The conversion process is handled by the `imageUrlToBase64` utility function, which transforms the image URL into a base64 string, ensuring compatibility with the visual recognition model <sup>[[1]](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/issues/5855)</sup>.

Additionally, you might want to verify that the Docker setup and the environment variables are correctly applied and that the application is restarted after making these changes. If the issue persists, check the logs for any specific error messages that might indicate what is going wrong during the image upload process.

Hi @Chunyu-Hugh! 👋 I'm [Dosu](https://dosu.dev), here to help you out with bugs, questions, and contributing. While you wait for a human maintainer, feel free to share more about your issue, and let's tackle it together!

<!-- Answer -->
To resolve the "Out of Memory" (OOM) error when deploying LobeChat version 1.84.10 on Vercel using the server db deployment mode with Ubuntu, you can follow these steps:

1. **Increase Memory Allocation**: Set the `NODE_OPTIONS` environment variable to `--max-old-space-size=8192` to increase the memory allocation for Node.js. This can help prevent memory issues during the build process <sup>[[1]](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/issues/6489)</sup>.

2. **Disable Build Cache**: Add the environment variable `VERCEL_FORCE_NO_BUILD_CACHE=1` to your Vercel project settings. This can help resolve the OOM error by preventing the use of cached builds, which might be consuming excessive memory <sup>[[1]](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/issues/6489)</sup>.

3. **Check Environment Variables**: Ensure that all necessary environment variables are correctly configured, including `DATABASE_URL`, `KEY_VAULTS_SECRET`, and `APP_URL`. Proper configuration of these variables is crucial to avoid database migration issues that could contribute to memory problems <sup>[[1]](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/issues/6489)</sup>.

4. **Database Configuration**: Make sure your Postgres database is correctly set up and that the `DATABASE_URL` is properly configured in Vercel. Depending on whether you are using a Serverless Postgres or Node Postgres instance, follow the specific configuration steps outlined in the LobeChat documentation <sup>[[2]](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/blob/main/docs/self-hosting/server-database/vercel.mdx)</sup>.

5. **Authentication Service**: Configure the Clerk authentication service by adding the `NEXT_PUBLIC_CLERK_PUBLISHABLE_KEY` and `CLERK_SECRET_KEY` environment variables in Vercel. This setup is necessary for the server db deployment mode to function correctly <sup>[[1]](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/issues/6489)</sup>.

By following these steps, you should be able to resolve the OOM error and successfully deploy LobeChat on Vercel.

body:
<!-- Answer -->
要解决在使用 Vercel 部署的 SearXNG 时出现的 "Failed to search: Forbidden" 错误，请确保以下几点：

1. **检查 `SEARXNG_URL` 配置**：确保在环境配置中正确设置了 `SEARXNG_URL`。这个 URL 是 SearXNG 客户端执行搜索时所依赖的。可以在环境变量或配置文件中检查这一点。

2. **启用 JSON 输出格式**：确保在 SearXNG 的配置中启用了 JSON 输出格式。可以通过以下步骤进行设置：
   - 访问 SearXNG 容器。
   - 编辑 `/etc/searxng/settings.yml` 文件。
   - 在 `formats` 部分中添加 `json`：
     ```yaml
     formats:
       - html
       - json
     ```
   - 重启 SearXNG 容器。

3. **Docker 部署**：如果使用 Docker，可以使用以下命令部署 SearXNG：
   ```bash
   docker run -d --name searxng -p 8080:8080 \
     -v /your/local/directory:/etc/searxng \
     -e SEARXNG_SETTINGS_FILE=/etc/searxng/settings.yml \
     searxng/searxng
   ```

通过确保 `SEARXNG_URL` 正确设置并启用 JSON 格式，应该可以解决 "Failed to search: Forbidden" 错误 <sup>[[1]](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/issues/6927)</sup><sup>[[2]](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/issues/6482)</sup>.

body:
<!-- Answer -->
I found a similar closed issue related to CORS and a 502 Bad Gateway error. The recommended solution was to ensure that the CORS configuration is correctly set up to allow requests from your domain. Specifically, check that the 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin' header is included in the response from your server. Additionally, review the CORS settings in your storage service to ensure they match the requirements for your application. For nginx, configure it to handle CORS headers properly by adding the necessary headers in your nginx configuration to allow cross-origin requests. Also, ensure that the backend service is running and accessible from the nginx server, and verify that the proxy_pass URL in your nginx configuration is correct <sup>[[1]](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/issues/1269)</sup>.

For your specific issue, you might want to check the CORS settings in your Docker deployment. The `MINIO_API_CORS_ALLOW_ORIGIN=*` setting in the `docker-compose.yml` file should allow all origins, which is typically sufficient to resolve CORS issues for MinIO <sup>[[2]](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/blob/main/docker-compose/local/docker-compose.yml)</sup>. If the error persists, ensure that other services like Casdoor or the main `lobe-chat` service do not have restrictive CORS settings. You might need to add similar CORS settings to these services if they are involved in the request causing the error.

body:
<!-- Answer -->
There is an open issue that seems similar to the problem you're experiencing, which is documented in [Issue #7580](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/issues/7580). The suggested solution for that issue involves ensuring a complete shutdown of the application by manually checking the Task Manager for any running processes related to "LobeHub-Nightly" and ending them if necessary. This might help in preventing the application from reopening unexpectedly <sup>[[1]](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/issues/7580)</sup>.

Additionally, the application uses a flag `isQuiting` during the `before-quit` event to handle cleanup operations, but it might not be terminating all background services properly. If this issue persists, checking for updates or patches that address this problem in future releases might be beneficial <sup>[[2]](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/blob/main/apps/desktop/src/main/core/App.ts)</sup><sup>[[3]](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/blob/main/apps/desktop/src/main/core/Browser.ts)</sup>.

The error message indicates that a GET request is being made to a mutation procedure, which typically requires a POST or PUT method for data modification.

Here are some steps you can take to address this issue:

1. **Verify HTTP Method**: Ensure that the LobeChat frontend is using the correct HTTP method (POST or PUT) when calling the `message.update` API path. The backend implementation supports updating a message by its ID, which usually requires a POST or PUT method <sup>[[1]](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/blob/main/src/services/message/server.ts)</sup>.

2. **Check Frontend Code**: Review the frontend code responsible for making the API call to `message.update`. Look for any logic that might incorrectly use the GET method instead of POST or PUT.

3. **Error Handling**: Investigate the `onmessage` handler in the frontend, as it seems to be involved in processing streaming responses. Ensure that it correctly handles JSON parsing and does not attempt to parse "undefined" values.

4. **Session Management**: Ensure that the state and session data management for tools/plugins like SearXNG is correctly implemented across multiple search queries. This involves actions defined in the `searchSlice` for managing state and session data <sup>[[2]](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/blob/main/src/store/chat/slices/builtinTool/actions/search.ts)</sup>.

By addressing these points, you should be able to resolve the JSON parsing error and ensure that subsequent SearXNG tool calls within the same chat session execute successfully.

The issue you're experiencing, where messages disappear from conversations when navigating around, might be related to a visibility issue rather than the messages being deleted. This is similar to a known issue where messages are not visible in the default topic view after certain actions, such as changing font size. The messages remain stored in the database, as you've confirmed by inspecting IndexedDB, but they may not be displayed correctly in the user interface.

Here are a few things you can try to resolve or further investigate the issue:

1. **Check Different Topics or Sections**: Sometimes, messages might not appear in the default view but can be found in other topics or sections. Try navigating through different parts of the application to see if the messages appear elsewhere.

2. **Browser Compatibility**: Since you're using the Brave browser, there might be specific handling or compatibility issues affecting message display. Testing the application in a different browser could help determine if the issue is browser-specific.

3. **Inspect Console for Errors**: Check the browser's developer console for any errors or warnings that might provide more insight into why messages are not displaying.

4. **Update or Revert Changes**: If possible, try updating to a newer version of the application if available, or reverting to a previous version to see if the issue persists.

If these steps do not resolve the issue, it might be beneficial to look into any recent changes or commits in the repository that address message persistence or retrieval issues, although no specific changes were found in version 1.84.12 related to this problem <sup>[[1]](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/issues/6600)</sup>.

body:
<!-- Answer -->
The issue you're experiencing with the Gemini 2.5 pro model outputting thinking tokens as normal tokens is known. In version v1.84.15, there were changes related to token handling, but it seems the current implementation does not differentiate between thinking and normal tokens for Gemini models. Implementing a foldable thinking block, similar to those used for DeepSeek R1 and Claude 3.7 pro models, could be a solution. However, the specific implementation details for these models are not available in the current documentation or codebase <sup>[[1]](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/blob/main/src/features/Conversation/components/MarkdownElements/LobeThinking/Render.tsx)</sup><sup>[[2]](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/blob/main/src/features/Conversation/components/MarkdownElements/Thinking/index.ts)</sup><sup>[[3]](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/blob/main/src/features/Conversation/components/MarkdownElements/Thinking/Render.tsx)</sup>. You might consider exploring the existing logic for rendering tokens in the `src/features/Conversation/components/MarkdownElements/Thinking/Render.tsx` file to adapt it for Gemini models.
